reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT) - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: The best university India has to offer, both national and international.

review_content.Placements: Hence, I’m still a student, so I’m not eligible for the placement cell till now, but the students get posted to many companies, clinics, or hospitals with great opportunities and salary. What I know is that they are providing the best hospital exposure in the university itself.
review_content.Infrastructure: Good LED TV for PPT, projector, library, easy study material access, and many more things, with great university infrastructure and the best teaching staff. The most important thing is that we are allowed to learn many more things despite the course we have taken.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Aeronautical Engineering - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Knowledgeable faculty and good infrastructure.

review_content.Placements: There's a placement policy in my college which gives us training for free, and the top recruiting companies of my course are Indigo and Hitech Digital Solutions. Though there is a penalty if we don't follow the placement policy, it's fair enough to have it.
review_content.Infrastructure: I'm a day scholar, and the bus facilities are amazing. My friends live in a hostel, and I've heard about some hostel facilities that are good enough. The campus is very interesting and fun to be in. The bus timings align perfectly with our timetable.

reviews_list.batch_info: BBA in Aviation, Hospitality, Travel and Tourism Management - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: I absolutely loved it. I am satisfied with the infrastructure.

review_content.Placements: From my seniors' passing out batch for BBA Aviation, the placement season is good with approximately 80 percent of students securing offers before graduation. I am yet to know more about it. Overall, it is good with good packages, which I heard from my seniors who recently got placements. Students are even getting the opportunity to go abroad for placements.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is quite good, with every necessity provided for the students to use. It has secure Wi-Fi connections. There is a big library with books on so many courses. Hostels of Parul University are good and cozy for living. Free medical support is provided to students of this university in the Parul Hospital. The mess food is of all different kinds and varieties. The food tastes good. We have huge playgrounds and an arena for indoor sports.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
reviews_list.review_title: Placement is not so good, but the infrastructure is good, and also the exposure it gives.

review_content.Placements: 50-60 percent of students got placed. The highest package is 23 LPA, and the lowest is 3 LPA. Recruiting companies areCognizant and Infosys for B.Tech and MBA. Many who got placed are the ones who were already placed somewhere or did an interview and had enough skills, so if you want to get an internship or a job, be ready to at least learn skills, as the company here selects a few.
review_content.Infrastructure: Good Wi-Fi and classrooms. The library is available. The quality of the medicine is available with free checkups. Wi-Fi is available everywhere in the hostel, library, or even food courts. The labs are also new, so nothing is needed. Canteen food is average, and they do provide fest and all.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
reviews_list.review_title: Average college, not the best.

review_content.Placements: Good placement, 85% B.Tech CSE batch placed. The highest package is 27 LPA, the lowest: 2.5 LPA, average is 5.7 LPA. Top recruiters are TCS, Accenture, Wipro, Infosys, IBM, Amazon. Roles offered are Software Developer, Data Analyst, Cloud Engineer, Software Engineer, Full Stack Developer.
review_content.Infrastructure: CSE dept: Modern labs with high-speed Wi-Fi, projector classrooms, CSE library, AI/ML labs. Hostels are clean. The hostel has AC/Non-AC rooms, 24/7 Wi-Fi, gym, sports grounds, hospital, average mess food (Guj/North Indian), canteens, ATMs. Room conditions depend on what you pay.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Sc. in Biotechnology - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Hostel is bad, placements are mid, campus is really good, hostel food is mid again.

review_content.Placements: Placement isn’t really bad in my course. I do see posters and stuff of people who are placed in good companies, so I think it’s good. I don’t really know about the package value. Top companies were Indian Oil, Infosys, and mainly pharma companies too. People get internships in different companies. I found internships in Corizo. Top roles are lab assistant, lead assistant, etc.
review_content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are okay. There are fans but no ACs, so it gets noisy and hot, especially in summers. Overall infrastructure is really good. It has a library, study room, labs, and they are pretty good too. Mess food is mid. They have added digital boards and better video players, and it’s done.

course_faqs.question: Is BPharma at Parul University Ahmedabad a good choice?
course_faqs.answer: Parul University offers BPharma for 4 years. Admission to this course is based on merit and entrance. Candidates must score a minimum of 50% aggregate in Class 12 and pass institution-level exams. The fee for BPharm may vary from INR 3.3 Lacs to INR 4.4 Lakh.

course_faqs.question: Is B.Pharm (lateral entry) course available at Parul University?
course_faqs.answer: Yes, Parul University offers a BPharm (lateral entry) course. It is a three-year course divided into six semesters. Candidates selected for admission are directly admitted to the second year of the course. Admission to the programme shall be granted on a merit basis. The eligible students can visit the university website to register and apply.

course_faqs.question: Which category has to pay more fees for BPharm courses at Parul University?
course_faqs.answer: The BPharm fees at Parul University is higher for the candidates who belong to the NRI category. Students of the NRI category have to pay INR 7.8 Lacs as BPharm fees. On the other hand, candidates who belong to the Management Quota are required to pay INR 5.4 Lacs for the BPharm course at Parul University. This difference in BPharm fees only applies to the first year admissions a Parul University. The BPharm fees for the lateral entry students is the same across all categories.

course_faqs.question: What is the BPharm fees for lateral entry students at Parul University?
course_faqs.answer: The Parul University BPharm fees for lateral entry student is the same for both Management Quota and NRI students. For NRI students, the BPharm lateral entry fees is INR 5.4 lakh. The fees is charged on per annum basis in three equal instalments. The fees is a combination of the tuition fees and university fees for Parul University BPharm lateral entry course.

overview_faqs.answer: Those who get selected via the admission process for BTech must proceed further to pay Parul University fee for BTech. Apart from this, candidates also have to pay an application fee of INR 300 at the time of filling the application form. faqs.question: Is Parul University admission open?
faqs.answer: Yes, Parul University admission are open. Students who whish to get admission to the courses offered at Parul University can apply now. Parul University application form is available online at university website. Students who fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria can apply online.

faqs.question: How do I get a seat at Parul University?
faqs.answer: Parul University Vadodara offers seats to applicants based on their merit in the qualifying exam or entrance test. The selection for courses such as BDes, MDes, BArch, BPT, BAMS, etc. is entrance-based. For most of the courses, admission is offered based on qualifying exam scores of the aspirants. Selected candidates have to report at the campus for document verification. Aspirants need to pay the course fees to confirm their seat.

faqs.question: How can I get admission to BTech at Parul University?
faqs.answer: In order to get admission to a four-year BTech course at Parul University, candidates are required to qualify for all the parameters of the selection process. The first step of the selection process is to fulfil the basic eligibility criteria required for BTech. Those who pass Class 12 in the respective discipline are eligible to apply for this course. Further, BTech admissions at Parul University are completely done based on candidates' past academic records and scores obtained in either JEE Main or GUJCET entrance exam. After qualifying for the respective entrance exam, candidates need to fill an online application form and submit their previous scorecards as proof for the selection process. The final seat allotment is done via GUJCET Counselling conducted by ACPC.

faqs.question: Can I pursue B.Pharm after completing my D Pharmacy course?
faqs.answer: Definitely, one can pursueB Pharmaafter completingD Pharma. The process is slightly different in terms that once a candidate completes a D Pharma, instead of taking admission to B Pharma directly and starting from the first year, the candidate can take admission to lateral entry. In this case, the candidate has to take admission in 2nd year and then the B Pharma shall be of three-year duration. This is a popular method of pursuing a B Pharma, wherein the candidates wish to expand their knowledge base as well as pursue a higher degree in Pharmacy.

reviews.review_heading: The best university India has to offer, both national and international.
reviews.review_text: Good LED TV for PPT, projector, library, easy study material access, and many more things, with great university infrastructure and the best teaching staff. The most important thing is that we are allowed to learn many more things despite the course we have taken.

reviews.review_heading: Knowledgeable faculty and good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: I'm a day scholar, and the bus facilities are amazing. My friends live in a hostel, and I've heard about some hostel facilities that are good enough. The campus is very interesting and fun to be in. The bus timings align perfectly with our timetable.

reviews.review_heading: I absolutely loved it. I am satisfied with the infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is quite good, with every necessity provided for the students to use. It has secure Wi-Fi connections. There is a big library with books on so many courses. Hostels of Parul University are good and cozy for living. Free medical support is provided to students of this university in the Parul Hospital. The mess food is of all different kinds and varieties. The food tastes good. We have huge playgrounds and an arena for indoor sports.

reviews.review_heading: Placement is not so good, but the infrastructure is good, and also the exposure it gives.
reviews.review_text: Good Wi-Fi and classrooms. The library is available. The quality of the medicine is available with free checkups. Wi-Fi is available everywhere in the hostel, library, or even food courts. The labs are also new, so nothing is needed. Canteen food is average, and they do provide fest and all.

reviews.review_heading: Average college, not the best.
reviews.review_text: CSE dept: Modern labs with high-speed Wi-Fi, projector classrooms, CSE library, AI/ML labs. Hostels are clean. The hostel has AC/Non-AC rooms, 24/7 Wi-Fi, gym, sports grounds, hospital, average mess food (Guj/North Indian), canteens, ATMs. Room conditions depend on what you pay.

reviews.review_heading: Hostel is bad, placements are mid, campus is really good, hostel food is mid again.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are okay. There are fans but no ACs, so it gets noisy and hot, especially in summers. Overall infrastructure is really good. It has a library, study room, labs, and they are pretty good too. Mess food is mid. They have added digital boards and better video players, and it’s done.

reviews.review_heading: Positive student experience with some areas for improvement.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure for my course/department are excellent, including full-speed unlimited Wi-Fi, classrooms with smart boards, benches with plugs, a huge library, a separate lab building, and a MAC lab. Hostel facilities are good, and the food quality in the mess is also good. Medical facilities are available, as the university has its own hospital. Sports and games options are plentiful, including outdoor and indoor activities, horse riding, swimming, and a gymnasium.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2026Offered by Parul Institute of LawReviewed on 18 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure, best extracurricular activities, average study.
reviews.review_text: There are properly facilitated classrooms, Wi-Fi is available, and there is a big library, but it is not air-conditioned. Hostels are good, but the mess is not that good. However, the canteen and cafés are the best. Medical facilities are available. Sports and games facilities are also available.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely dissatisfied with the university.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are in terrible condition. In the name of projector screens, the wall has been covered with a thick layer of lime, and benches are pretty old too. The hostel is in poor condition, and lights are not working properly. The cleaning staff members are not maintaining cleanliness. The issue of food is also very disturbing for students, as the taste is very bad. Medical facilities are average.

reviews.review_heading: Parul University is best for events and campus life, but strict rules which I don't like.
reviews.review_text: Basically, I like the infrastructure. I am a BBA aviation student, so in my department, there's an aviation infrastructure plan class and aviation dummies. The courses are good, my department is well-furnished, and work is going on. It's under construction. More departments are also good for this, like the design department and the B.Tech building. It is a good campus, and the facilities are also very good.

reviews.review_heading: Okay, the college is really nice.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are the best and are in a neat and clean environment. The atmosphere of the college is too good. I don’t know about the mess, but in canteens and all stalls, there is good food. Sports are also a part of our study, and the facilities are also good, and the library is also very comfy.

reviews.review_heading: Parul is a decent private university in 2026.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is pretty good, I would say. The labs are well-equipped, and the classrooms have good long benches with smart boards in every class. There are many libraries on the campus. I personally used the one in the admin block. You will find various books related to your subjects there, along with desktops in the library to be used for academic purposes.

reviews.review_heading: I suggest students take admission in this college in any other courses.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure for the course is average. The infrastructure in the hostel is not good because we don't get enough hot water. The food quality is also not good. The mess staff members and reactors also sometimes do not behave properly. It looks like we are surviving for our lives, and the other facilities of the hostel are average.

reviews.review_heading: I like the college for its events and the quality of studies.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are basic, which helps us prepare a foundation, but to grow. We need to seek help from other universities, like government colleges, especially during our major projects. Facilities like a hostel, I don’t have an idea, as I am a day scholar, but sports and games are excellent here. I enjoy indoor sports in my free time, and the canteen is also good on campus.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and social life.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is awesome, and the facilities that we have are very good. Wi-Fi is so good, and classrooms are good and hygienic. The library is so great, and the reading area is too spacious, and we see the hostel facilities are awesome.

reviews_list.review_title: Annamalai University review.

review_content.Placements: The placement was good, but not with very big companies. You can't get a good job with a decent package. I'm just studying in third year, so I don't know much about placements. But our college has good placements. The faculty members provide hands-on practice instead of just theories a lot, so it helps you upgrade your skills and get placed easily.
review_content.Infrastructure: Good infrastructure in college, old but in good condition. Nice architecture and a good environment for study. Hostel quality is poor, not so hygienic and clean. reviews_list.batch_info: B.E. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2018
reviews_list.review_title: Decent academy support with a good campus, but needs more practical exposure.

review_content.Placements: Around 60%-70% of students from the B.E. Civil course got placed. The highest package offered is around 6 LPA, the lowest is around 2 LPA, and the average is about 3.5 LPA. Top recruiters include NGOs, media houses, and educational firms. Around 50% of students got internships in companies like Tech for India, Times Group, and local startups. Common roles include content writers, research assistants, and HR trainees.
review_content.Infrastructure: The college provides good facilities for our department, including smart classrooms, fast Wi-Fi, and well-equipped computer labs. The library is quiet and stocked with useful study material. Hostels are clean and have basic amenities. The food in the mess is average, while the canteen offers a better variety. Medical help is available on campus with a health center. Sports facilities, such as a playground and indoor games, are provided to encourage student recreation. Overall, the infrastructure is decent and supports both academics and student life well.

overview_faqs.question: Is Annamalai University distance education degree valid?
overview_faqs.answer: The online/distance degrees offered by the Centre for Distance and Online Education at Annamalai University are valid. Previously, the University Grants Commission (UGC) did not approve its courses starting from 2015. However, Annamalai University DDE received relief from the Madras High Court in an order dated 21.01.2023. Subsequently, following a reassessment by the UGC, Annamalai DDE achieved a qualifying score of 3.38, which led to extending the validity of its programmes until 2027.

content.Placements: Each student gets 2-4 offers from various companies, and the placement is 100 percent. There are many companies that take students from our college, and last time the company Capgemini took over more than 700 students from VSB Engineering College located in Karur.

individual_reviews.title: Annamalai University review.

content.Placements: The placement was good, but not with very big companies. You can't get a good job with a decent package. I'm just studying in third year, so I don't know much about placements. individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2018
individual_reviews.title: Decent academy support with a good campus, but needs more practical exposure.

content.Placements: Around 60%-70% of students from the B.E. Civil course got placed. The highest package offered is around 6 LPA, the lowest is around 2 LPA, and the average is about 3.5 LPA. Top recruiters include NGOs, media houses, and educational firms. Around 50% of students got internships in companies like Tech for India, Times Group, and local startups. Common roles include content writers, research assistants, and HR trainees.
content.Infrastructure: The college provides good facilities for our department, including smart classrooms, fast Wi-Fi, and well-equipped computer labs. The library is quiet and stocked with useful study material. Hostels are clean and have basic amenities. The food in the mess is average, while the canteen offers a better variety. Medical help is available on campus with a health center. Sports facilities, such as a playground and indoor games, are provided to encourage student recreation. Overall, the infrastructure is decent and supports both academics and student life well.

paragraphs: Annamalai University admission 2026 includes the submission of an application form, appearance for the entrance test, the release of the merit list, the counselling process and fee payment. students can follow the -wise Annamalai University admission process as given below:
1: Annamalai University Application Process 2026

The university accepts applications via online mode. Eligible students can visit the university's official website (www.annamalaiuniversity.ac.in) to apply. Further, the aspirants shall ensure that they apply within the due date.
2: Appear for the Entrance Test

If a student fills out the initial application process, they now have to appear for the course-specific entrance test. For undergraduate engineering, i.e., BTech course, students should turn out for the Tamil Nadu Engineering Admissions (TNEA).
3: Release of the Merit List
Based on the entrance test scores, the University will release the merit list of eligible students for the next round of the admission process.
4: Counselling & Fee Payment

In this , students whose names appeared in the merit list released by the University are then required to appear for the counselling process. After the counselling round, Annamalai University released a final list of selected students for final admission. Selected students are then required to pay theAnnamalai University admission feeto confirm their admission.

Annamalai University fee is cumulative of multiple components, such as tuition fee, hostel fee, etc. Some of the fee components are charged one-time, while some have to be paid semester-wise or annually, such as tuition fees. Hence, aspirants must take the exam and secure a valid score.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: I am absolutely dissatisfied because of everything about this college.

content.Placements: Only a few students are placed, and the package is very low. You could find a job like that anywhere, and it is done by low-level companies. Internship level is also very low. I don’t know about top roles, but the average role is minimum-wage worker.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is very bad. We don’t even get classrooms for some of the classes and have to study outside. Nor do we get access to labs, and there is no Wi-Fi. There is a library, but the books there are useless. There is no mess or medical facilities.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor Of Computer Applications (BCA) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Average study but poor college life.

content.Placements: There are very low placements. Do not expect so much about placements. There are very few companies for recruitment in our course. The average package offered in our course is 3 LPA. There are very few students who got internship. In conclusion it does not offer many opportunities.
content.Infrastructure: The library is available but there is no Wi-Fi available in it. Classrooms are average. There is no mess available in college. Canteen is available but it always remain close as there is no food available. College gives time to time opportunities for participation in various sports and games. NCC is also present.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (B.B.A.) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Review of our Aggarwal College Ballabgarh.

content.Placements: 2/3 students placed in my course last placement drive. The highest package for UG student 3.7 LPA, the lowest package for UG student 2.1 LPA. Top companies like TCS, HDFC Life, Bajaj Finance, and etc. 70 percent students got internship in companies like Escort Group. Top roles offered in HR, Finance, Marketing, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi enabled smart classes and hi-tech labs, huge library. Canteen food cost for one person 70. Medical facilities and facilities for physically impaired person, lift facility, emergency exit plan. Working on hostel facility. Sports activities weekly.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Computer Applications (MCA) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Good college with good placements and average hostel life and facilities, rest campus is good.

content.Placements: Placement criteria are good and above average. Placement opportunities are available in this college, and if you have a good skill set in any programming language or data analytics, then you can easily get a package up to 10+ LPA. I am talking about the MCA department.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure of the course is average, or I would say okay, as the course is outdated and the subjects are repeated, since we have already studied them in BCA. So for MCA, the course is mostly the same with some little changes. I would say the MCA course should be updated to gain new knowledge. Talking about the hostel, the hostel living is good if you get a 3 bed room, but if you get a 4 bed room or a 6 bed room, then the experience is literally not good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Mathematics - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Teachers are good, supportive, and well-qualified. Infrastructure is so cool.

content.Placements: In my course, not many students get placements. I'm new in college, so I don't know the highest and the lowest packages offered to students. From our seniors, I got to know that not many students get placements directly from college. Almost 60 percent of students get internships from my course. Companies like Wozti Infotech and HCL hire students from our college.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms and the library are so good. The hostel fans are not working. Labs are also good and working. In the hostel, Wi-Fi is not working regularly. Hostel mess (food) is also good. Medical facilities are also good. Sports like kabaddi and other athletic games happen from time to time, so students can easily participate.

MDU Rohtak has been ranked well by the NIRF under the 'University' category. Through the years, the NIRF rankings for MDU Rohtak indicate the institute's strong performance in crucial areas such as the Quality of Education, Conducting Impactful Research, the Expertise of Faculty members, and Overall Institutional Management. These good rankings not only prove the institute's positive reputation but also highlight its excellence across diverse domains, evaluated against the standards established by the NIRF. It has been seen that in the 'University' category, the institute's ranks have shown a fluctuating trend when evaluated against the ranking of the prior year. In 2025, MDU Rohtak's rank is #101, the same as last year's rank in the 'University' category by the NIRF ranking.
It has been seen that within the category of 'Pharmacy', the institute's ranking has fallen when compared with the previous year's ranking. In 2025, MDU Rohtak fell 5 ranks to #43 rank in the 'Pharmacy' category by the NIRF ranking. This is the second consecutive year that the institute has slipped in the rankings.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence) (Lateral Entry) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: A place to relax and win in life.

content.Placements: It provides an easy package at our university. They confirm 100 percent placement offers. The lowest package starts from 3 LPA but can go up to 18 LPA. The highest package is 45 LPA, and it is none other than a brilliant student of Shoolini University. Our university provides us with a space to work and win.
content.Infrastructure: It has a very beautiful campus, no honking, no noise, it's all greenery, and peaceful with amazing place to sit and relax. Our hostel is so clean with amazing people working to keep it peaceful, with different events like marathon and yoga sessions in the morning.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: The university location is great and peaceful.

content.Placements: 85 percent of students are placed. The highest package offered is 24 LPA, the lowest package offered is 1 LPA, and the average package offered is 5 LPA. Top recruiters are Accenture, Dell, HCL, and many more. 70 percent in AWS, Accenture, Hitachi, and ITC are some of the companies. Roles offered are senior software developer, General Manager, and AI developer.
content.Infrastructure: In our college, Wi-Fi, computer labs, and library are available. Top-notch classrooms, electricity, a purified water project, and research labs. Facilities in the hostel are good. The quality of food is nice, and a medical facility is available 24 hours a day at the nearby hospital. Sports and games are average.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Great infrastructure, updated curriculum, and more. Come if a remote location is not a problem.

content.Placements: The real data is that about 90% of all students got placed. The top package this year is about 12 LPA, the lowest is about 3 LPA, and the average package is about 6 LPA. There are no very big names among the companies (on-campus), and the top ones are TCS & Infosys. Most students got internships, including many completing their 1st year. Top roles are related to SDE, Data Science, and AI.
content.Infrastructure: The library is pretty big and useful, with a huge set of books. Wi-Fi is amazing (hostel excluded). You'll find exceptions even on roads while you are walking on campus. Classrooms & labs for this course in the AI building are unarguably one of the best in the country, not exaggerating. Hostel rooms are comparable to the ones from dorms of international universities, with the option of attached washrooms too. Even common washrooms are clean all the time as they're thoroughly cleaned several times throughout the day. Mess is pretty, and food is decent too. We have to pay extra for non-vegetarian food.

individual_reviews.course: BCA in Full Stack Developer - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Faculty members are knowledgeable and supportive, always willing to help beyond expectations.

content.Placements: The program offers decent placement opportunities with reputed companies visiting the campus. While core jobs are available students with good internships have a better chance. The placement cell is supportive but its outreach could improve. This time I understand that my college is good.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure for my course is well-developed with spacious classrooms, projectors and access to labs with updated equipment. The hostel is clean and secure offering basic amenities like Wi-Fi and laundry though food quality can improve.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Agriculture - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Excellent college and satisfied with the faculty.

content.Placements: Placement is 100%. The college provides good placement facilities and internship programs, including the opportunity to gain experience and knowledge. Different types of top companies appear for placement in different areas of expertise. In the agriculture course, different companies have different approaches.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure for my course is quite good. It provides well-furnished smart classes with projectors. Different labs according to subjects are provided with the necessary chemicals and equipment. The different equipment is provided for good knowledge.

admission_overview.college_name: Shoolini University Course Admission 2025: Eligibility, Selection Process & Dates

paragraphs: Shoolini University is accepts admission on a merit basis and an entrance basis.The university admits nationally level exams such as SAT India, JEE Main, CUET, CAT, MAT, etc.Additionally, Shoolini offers an entrance exam, known as SU-SAT, in selectcourses.With more than 180 undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs in fields such as Science, Engineering, Management, Commerce, Pharmacy, and Law,among others, students are offered a great choice.Lateral entry admissions and Summit Research Program courses in Engineering are also permitted in the university.

The University offers various courses in the fields ofEngineering, Law and Science etc. Students seeking admission must meet the course specific eligibility and selection conditions. However, the university also offers a BTech Lateral Entry course. The following table mentions the eligibility and selection for some of the popularShoolini University courses.
CUET UG/ SU-SAT/JEE Main/SAT India+ Faculty Interaction
The admission process at Shoolini University consists of multiple s, which are as follows.

1. Shoolini University Application Process 2025Candidates are required to apply online for all courses offered by Shoolini University. During the application, an application fee needs to be paid. For BBA, BCom, and MBA courses. Students can check the detailed Shoolini University fee structure here.

2. Selection RoundsShoolini University admits students based on various entrance exam scores such as CLAT, GMAT, MAT, etc., for various course admission such as BA LLB, BBA, BDes among others. For UG and PG courses, the selection criteria for PhD course admission is based on a multiple-choice entrance test and assessment of research aptitude through concept notes & faculty interaction.

3. Merit List & CounsellingBased on the candidates' performance in the selection rounds, the university prepares a merit list. Those who find their names on the merit list are invited to the counselling round. During this stage, candidates need to confirm their admission by paying the required fee.

nirf.description:
Shoolini University has been ranked well by the NIRF under the 'Overall' category. Through the years, the NIRF rankings for Shoolini University indicate the institute's strong performance in crucial areas such as the Quality of Education, Conducting Impactful Research, the Expertise of Faculty members, and Overall Institutional Management. These good rankings not only prove the institute's positive reputation but also highlight its excellence across diverse domains, evaluated against the standards established by the NIRF. When evaluated against the ranking of the past years, it has been noticed that in the 'Overall' category, the institute's ranks have shown a decreasing trend. In 2025, Shoolini University fell 12 ranks to #101 rank in the 'Overall' category by the NIRF ranking.
It has been seen that within the category of 'University', the institute's ranking has scaled up when compared with the previous year's ranking. In 2025, Shoolini University climbed 1 rank to #69 rank in the 'University' category by the NIRF ranking. This is the second consecutive year that the institute has ascended in the rankings.
It is to be noticed that the institute has shown a fluctuating trend in the 'Engineering' category as compared to the ranking of preceding years. In 2025, Shoolini University fell 9 ranks to #101 rank in the 'Engineering' category by the NIRF ranking. Throughout the preceding two years, the rank has oscillated but is currently stable.
In the 'Pharmacy' category, the institute's ranks have shown a fluctuation when compared with the previous year's ranking. In 2025, Shoolini University fell 14 ranks to #44 rank in the 'Pharmacy' category by the NIRF ranking.

reviews.review_heading: A place to relax and win in life.
reviews.review_text: It has a very beautiful campus, no honking, no noise, it's all greenery, and peaceful with amazing place to sit and relax. Our hostel is so clean with amazing people working to keep it peaceful, with different events like marathon and yoga sessions in the morning.

reviews.review_heading: The university location is great and peaceful.
reviews.review_text: In our college, Wi-Fi, computer labs, and library are available. Top-notch classrooms, electricity, a purified water project, and research labs. Facilities in the hostel are good. The quality of food is nice, and a medical facility is available 24 hours a day at the nearby hospital. Sports and games are average.

reviews.review_heading: Great infrastructure, updated curriculum, and more. Come if a remote location is not a problem.
reviews.review_text: The library is pretty big and useful, with a huge set of books. Wi-Fi is amazing (hostel excluded). You'll find exceptions even on roads while you are walking on campus. Classrooms & labs for this course in the AI building are unarguably one of the best in the country, not exaggerating. Hostel rooms are comparable to the ones from dorms of international universities, with the option of attached washrooms too. Even common washrooms are clean all the time as they're thoroughly cleaned several time...

reviews.review_heading: Faculty members are knowledgeable and supportive, always willing to help beyond expectations.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure for my course is well-developed with spacious classrooms, projectors and access to labs with updated equipment. The hostel is clean and secure offering basic amenities like Wi-Fi and laundry though food quality can improve.

reviews.review_heading: Excellent college and satisfied with the faculty.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure for my course is quite good. It provides well-furnished smart classes with projectors. Different labs according to subjects are provided with the necessary chemicals and equipment. The different equipment is provided for good knowledge.

reviews.review_heading: This university is good for your overall development.
reviews.review_text: The college has modern infrastructure, and the hostels provide very good services, especially in my hostel, for village students. The boys' hostel is located off the campus, and the girls' hostel is on the campus. There is 24 hour Wi-Fi service available. The labs are good, and there is an Apple lab in the AI block.

reviews.review_heading: Good college and my college offers a great.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure for my course is well-developed, with spacious classrooms, high-speed Wi-Fi, and well-equipped labs that support practical learning. The department also has access to a good library with relevant reference materials and digital resources. Hostel facilities are decent, with clean rooms and regular maintenance.

reviews.review_heading: It has great labs for research and a peaceful campus.
reviews.review_text: The campus is well-equipped with different facilities. For food technology students, there are advanced labs for research. The university itself carries many patients which helps a lot in research programs. It has modern classrooms with Wi-Fi ensuring a seamless learning experience. The hostel is good here. There is an indoor cafe built in girls' hostel. It has different games and modernized infrastructure which make it feel like our second home.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available are good. The washrooms are clean, classrooms are clean and spacious, and there is good Wi-Fi connectivity. The library is also amazing, open 24/7, 365 days a year, which is the best part. The hostel is also good, with good rooms, good food, and medical facilities available.

reviews.review_heading: Excellent campus and reliable faculty.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is very bad. Labs are not that bad. Quality of food is okay-okay. Some of the classrooms are very well-facilitated, and some are good ones. Good medical facilities are available. From time to time, game matches are held, and there is a sports complex with a gym also included in it.

reviews.review_heading: Strong digital marketing program with great placement and scenic campus life.
reviews.review_text: Our department has smart classrooms and high-speed Wi-Fi. The infrastructure is modern and well-maintained. Hostel is clean. The mess food is decent with a mix of dishes, and the mess offered good snacks. Medical facilities are available on campus, and sports like basketball, volleyball, badminton, and gym are also provided.

reviews.review_heading: The environment and atmosphere here are really good.
reviews.review_text: Well, I would say that the facilities are fairly good and good Wi-Fi speed, and libraries (study rooms) are there. Overall the facilities are good and the hostel is near campus. It is a very big advantage for me at the very least. Also, there are proper labs in my department.

reviews.review_heading: After so many days of worrying, I finally found my fit.
reviews.review_text: My department is very well equipped with laboratories which are really important for my course. Hostel facilities are at par, especially with the dead stories that I have heard from my older cousins. The hostel has been a relief. Moreover, they do listen. Feedback is taken often and acted upon.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the university for now.
reviews.review_text: They have high-speed Wi-Fi everywhere but in the AI block they have a speed of around 200 Mbps. The food is average and their cleanliness is maintained throughout the university. All the equipment is present in the labs and maintained by the university.

reviews.review_heading: The college is good, they do provide placements, and everything is amazing.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure are good. I didn't opt for a hostel, so I don't know about it. There are clean washrooms, a 24/7 library, and good Wi-Fi. The classrooms are clean, and the food is average. Medical facilities are available, which are good. There are sports and games, a stadium, a basketball court, and a gym to stay fit.

overview_faqs.question: When did B.Pharm start at L M College of Pharmacy?
overview_faqs.answer: LM College of Pharmacy was set up in 1947 by the philanthropic trust, Ahmedabad Education Society, Navrangpura, Ahmedabad. Its first programme was the Bachelor of Pharmacy programme and at the time it was affiliated with Bombay University.This makes the institution more than 77 years old. LM College of Pharmacy is now affiliated with Gujarat Technical University and is approved by both the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) and the Pharmacy Council of India (PCI). Now the university carries close to 10 courses ranging from a diploma in pharmacy to a doctorate in pharmacy.

overview_faqs.question: Is B.Pharm at L M College of Pharmacy approved by PCI?
overview_faqs.answer: Yes, LM College of Pharmacy is approved by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) and Pharmacy Council of India (PCI). Furthermore, the LM College of Pharmacy is affiliated with Gujarat Technical University.LM College of Pharmacy offers diploma and undergraduate programmes in Pharmacy as grant-in-aid programmes, as well as, programmes like Doctor of Pharmacy (Pharm.D), Pharm.D Post Baccalaureate (PB), Post-graduation in Pharmacy as self-financed programmes. The grant-in-aid programmes are funded by public institutions and the self-financed programmes are self-financed by the institution.

reviews.review_heading: Good place for the pharmacy students and great faculty.
reviews.review_text: Facilities in our college are average because it has been made since 1947 and not renovated. So, infrastructure is like poor, but also good. The classroom is okay but not much because it's very poor and sometimes something happens, like a rat dying. Food quality in our canteen is also good. They have sports and games and win with gratitude.

reviews.review_heading: Nice environment with nice faculty and great education.
reviews.review_text:
2 buildings: 1 main building and another for Pharma.D are there. 
Labs are clean and well maintained; classrooms are clean and well arranged. Has its own pet house consisting of animals for research. The washrooms are cleaned on a daily basis. Campus consists of 2 libraries.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good teaching faculty and placements, but a very strict attendance policy.
reviews.review_text: Experienced, dedicated and expert faculty members are hired for each department. They provide guidance for competitive examinations like GPAT and even conduct Pre-GPAT exam. The campus’ placement percentage is almost 100% for the postgraduate students. More than 60% of the graduates are settled in USA. The Laboratories are well-equipped with high quality instruments, lecture theater, spacious seminar hall and an auditorium. There is a Library with Wi-Fi facility enriched with national and intern...

reviews.review_heading: Good for pharmacy educational courses I.
reviews.review_text: Labs, classrooms and sports facilities are good but hostel problems are there in our college this time. Some rules and regulations are also there, which are good for students. Free Wi-Fi is also there. Good communication skills are there with faculty members .

reviews.review_heading: In this college, all the faculty were very good and educated.
reviews.review_text: There are no college hostels in campus. You can find many hostels and PGs nearby the college. May be it will cost high but you can find them easily near college. It costs around INR 6,000 per month in PG and hostel costs around INR 45,000 per semester.

reviews.review_heading: It has a huge campus, and many other students from the country are studying in our college.
reviews.review_text: There is a good Wi-Fi facility, and every lab is available. We have good classrooms, and a library is also available in the college. Hostel facility is not so good but the food served is best in our mess. Canteen medical facility, and sports and games are also available in our college.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides good quality of education for students.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is quite good, and it will give you a feel of the 1950s. The library is one of the best things here, and some books are very rare. Classrooms are good, but there is no Wi-Fi facility here. Labs are developing, and you can get access to so many instruments.

reviews.review_heading: Really good and helpful faculty to every student.
reviews.review_text: In our course, we have a library, laboratories for each course, canteen, classrooms, and a projector room. Wi-Fi is reachable to the whole campus so there is no issue for the reachability. Labs are clean and well-equipped.

reviews.review_heading: Good college satisfied because of faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Sophisticated labs were available with access to all instruments related to the study. The library had access to a wide range of books, journals, and recent manuscripts. The quality of the hostel was average. The quality of food was also average. For sports and games facilities were quite good.

reviews.review_heading: Best faculty in HAP and Pharmaceutical Organic Chemistry.
reviews.review_text: There has been no boy's hostel in this college for many years they say it is under construction but I don't think it is true. No boy's hostel is available on campus for boys and girls. They say there is a hostel for girls but not for boys, the hostel is under construction.

reviews.review_heading: Nice college and infrastructure would recommend.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the hostels were average, not too good, not too bad. The classrooms were a bit small from that I was expecting, but there was Wi-Fi service available that helped everyone in studying. The canteen was clean, and the food was served in a good manner.

reviews.review_heading: Life at L.M. College of Pharmacy.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good, but classrooms could be better. Laboratories are good for chemistry and pharmacology practicals, but the pharmacognosy and pharmaceutics departments need to improve laboratories. The college has a good canteen, the library is up to date, and all the books are there.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the college is good.
reviews.review_text: Sports facilities are available in our college. The infrastructure is good.

reviews.review_heading: My college are good at providing facilities.
reviews.review_text: The college has all the necessary infrastructure, facilities, and equipment. Classrooms have projectors, the library has ACs. Sports courts and big ground for the students. Quality of food available in this college is better than other colleges. Hostel rooms are comfortable with Wi-Fi facility.

college_info.intro:
The Maharaja Sayajirao University of Baroda Vadodara (university of baroda) has BTech/B.E., MBA, and BSc as popular programmes. The main objective of the MSU University Baroda is to provide fundamental knowledge of Computer Science and Engg. The students are taught ethical attitudes, professionalism, and soft skills. MS University in Baroda BTech and BSc students are placed in top companies such as Standard Radiators Pvt. Ltd., Caparo India Pvt. Ltd., and others. The MSUniversity of Baroda students can become Researchers or Teachers or can take up various job roles as per their preference. The MS University of Baroda (Maharaja Sayajirao Baroda) students can take up non-technical jobs in fields like Sales, Marketing, etc.
The MSU Department of Computer Science and Engineering is affiliated with other national level technical bodies like Computer Society of India (CSI), Institute of Engineers (IE), Institute of Electronics and Telecommunication Engineers (IETE) and Indira Gandhi National Open University (IGNOU). In collaboration with CSI, the MSU department has been organising several workshops, seminars & technical talks. content.Placements: The level of placement is moderate. In this government college, we have to find internships by ourselves, as it does not offer any paid internships. Placements are okay. 70 percent of students get placements, and others just go and prepare for master's.
content.Infrastructure: It is a government college, but believe me, facilities are insane. It has a center AC. Classrooms have smart boards and have a good environment. We have our own app for attendance. The attendance only fills if we apply via the college app, or else we do not get a present mark.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Applied Chemistry - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: A Best college to study.

content.Placements: Each year more than 60% students get directly placed from campus placement, and the rest also get their job with the help of placement cell and the department. The placement cell is getting wider day by day. The role of placement cell is very crucial and good for the students of M.Sc. Applied Chemistry. Also, this placement cell not only works for one department; in MS University, there are respective placement cells in each faculty, so no need to worry just maintain a good academic record and the rest will be good.
content.Infrastructure: Awesome building and facilities at laboratory and library. Overall, a good building and a good environment. Free Wi-Fi placement for all students with secure privacy and proxy network. Everyone has their unique username and password for Wi-Fi login. The parking facility in the faculty is also good.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. LL.B. (Hons.) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Law at MSU, academics, and after hours.

content.Placements: Placements at Faculty of Law, MSU, aren't very strong overall, but good opportunities can be secured if you've consistently worked on building your CV through internships and extracurricular activities. Many students opt for litigation by working under advocates though breaking into this field often requires strong professional connections. Recently, one of my seniors secured a placement with a package of around 4 LPA which is encouraging. Still, most students prefer preparing for government exams like judiciary or UPSC after completing their degree.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com. Hons.) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: MSU Baroda college is good.

content.Placements: MSU Baroda is a very good college for B.Com (honors). Subjects of this course are very helpful for further studies. Many students get high package from this college. Many managers and accountants roles are provided by Maharaja Sayajirao University of Baroda.
content.Infrastructure: Our college has very good infrastructure. College has many rooms like 10 to 12 rooms, with different names. There is free Wi-Fi at the college. There are good benches and fans in the classroom.
content.Faculty: Teachers at this college are very helpful, qualified, and knowledgeable. This college difficulty is medium like in the internal exams. But in the external exam difficulty is high. This college's difficulty is high because of the great placement.

individual_reviews.course: Diploma in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: It's good for civil courses; they provide enough knowledge.

content.Placements: More than 40% of students were placed in our course. 1.4 Lacs is the lowest, and the average is 2 LPA, while 4 LPA is the highest package. Nirma, Larsen, Toubro, Ghadi, Kent, Alambic, Voltra, Nyra, etc., are recruiting companies for our course. Top roles offered include draftsman, site engineer, assistant engineer, surveyor, supervisor, and various other positions.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure for our course or department is good and includes available Wi-Fi, big classrooms, a drawing lab, a library, etc. The quality of food is good, but not that much better; there are different types of food available in our canteen. Students receive free medicine and treatment, and we have extensive grounds and facilities that include a volleyball court, basketball court, swimming pool, and gymnasium.

college_info.intro:
Guru Ghasidas Vishwavidyalaya offers numerous UG, PG, and Doctoral courses across streams such as Engineering, Humanities, Science, Commerce, Law, Education, Medicine and Health Sciences, etc. The popular courses at GGV Bilaspur include MSc and MA. The courses are offered in full-time mode.
MA graduates from GGV are acquainted with skills such as social, economic, political, historical, philosophical, and ideological. The course provides an understanding and importance of literature, and promotes the moral, mental, and intellectual development of the students. The MA programme provides an understanding of the influence of literature on society. MA graduates from GGV can opt for government and civil services.
MSc at Guru Ghasidas Vishwavidyalaya Bilaspur provides students with the fundamental knowledge of subjects such as Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Botany, Zoology, Microbiology, etc. The MSc programme also assists students in developing analytical skills to critically analyse scientific and critical data to pursue higher studies. MSc graduates from GGV can also pursue careers such as Software Developer, Web Developer, Data Scientist, Lecturer, Research Scientist, etc. Further, MSc graduates can also prepare for government and competitive exams.

review_summary.college_name: Guru Ghasidas Vishwavidyalaya Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.A. LL.B - Batch of 2030
individual_reviews.title: Average college for students of law. Teachers are very good, and the college infrastructure is good.

content.Placements: Not that many placements were provided. I think 40% of students are getting placements in this college, Guru Ghasidas Vishwavidyalaya. Almost 50% of students secure internships during their B.A. studies. LL.B. from this college. The highest package is 8 LPA, and the lowest package is 2.5 LPA. Top recruiting companies are law firms. Local top roles offer me the opportunity to communicate with a wide range of people.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure of our B.A. The LL.B. law department is very nice and well-settled. All books are available in the law department library. We didn't face any problems there. The Wi-Fi also works very well. The hostel is very good for accommodation. The food is also very good and edible. The cafeteria, medical facilities, and sports games are also very good. Games are played on their scheduled time.

individual_reviews.course: Masters of Social Work - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Very unique chance to get.

content.Placements: Placements are very average in this course. For this course mostly students are placed in different health care. In the government sector, there are very few jobs. Students are placed as nutritionists, mental health advisors, child welfare specialists, etc. In India, there is less scope, but in foreign countries, there is a very good scope.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi all over the campus with CCTV security. There are different grounds for different sports. The library is good. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated. There are different canteens inside the college. In college, there is first aid medical present.

individual_reviews.course: M.A. in Political Science - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely good college for this course.

content.Placements: For this course, placements are very low. Students mostly get jobs in different colleges and universities as assistant professors. Some students opted for Ph.D. For internship, there is a 6-month compulsory internship in government colleges as guest lecturer.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is good. Wi-Fi is available all over the campus with CCTV security. Labs are spacious. Classrooms are good and digitally updated. Hostels are 2-seated or 3-seated rooms. Mess food is average. Library is good but has timings. There are different indoor and outdoor grounds for different sports.

individual_reviews.course: M. Pharm. (Pharmacology) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: A very good government college is less expensive.

content.Placements: Placements are very average. Students are placed through referral from the teachers and seniors. Students are placed in different sectors like pharmacovigilance, clinical trials, Medical coding, etc. Salaries given mostly range between 30k and 35k per month. Cipla and Sunpharma are the top recruiters.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available all over the campus, and CCTV security is in place. There are many hostels inside the campus. Classrooms are spacious and have all the facilities like projectors and smartboards. Labs are spacious and have all the apparatus used in industry. There are many cafeteria restaurants inside the campus. There are many grounds for different sports.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: According to me, this college has value for money.

content.Placements: I recently took admission in B.Tech in ECE at GGU. My JEE CRL rank is 84000. After coming to campus, I heard from professors that there are no placements in this college. Only 2 to 5 percent of students are placed here. The highest package is 5 LPA on campus, and the lowest is Rs 90,000 per annum. Top recruiting companies are TCS, Mahindra, and Tata Steel. 50 to 60 percent of students got internships by college or outside sources. Top role is circular designer.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is overall good. Wi-Fi is also available but it does not work properly. On this campus there is a central library. In hostels, the food they provide like roti is so hard and dal is fully water. One thing that is good here is snacks in the evening. The sports facility is good but not like NIT and IIT. There is one cafeteria in our college. Free medical facilities are provided by college.

faqs.answer: A:    GLA University offers four-year courses of BTech and BTech (Hons). For admission to BTech course at GLA University, the minimum eligibility is to pass Class 12 with Physics & Mathematics as compulsory subjects along with Chemistry/ Computer Science with an aggregate of 50% (45% aggregate for SC/ ST) in the above subjects taken together and 50% aggregate overall. faqs.answer: For admission to the MBA programme at GLA University, candidates must complete a UG degree with a minimum of 50% aggregate. Also, candidates based on valid scores in CAT/ MAT/ UPSEE/ GLAET will be shortlisted for the Group Discussion (GD) and Personal Interview (PI) round.

faqs.question: Does GLA University accept admission through CAT or MAT?
faqs.answer: Yes, at GLA University the MBA admissions are divided into CAT, MAT, XAT, or UPSEE.GLAET also accepts the application of candidates to the MBA programme.The last stage involves group discussion and personal interview.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission to GLA University?
faqs.answer: No, admission to all courses at GLA University is entirely entrance-based. GLA University Mathura conducts an in-house entrance exam namely, GLAET, for admission to its various UG and PG courses in all the streams. Those who are interested to get admission in to either of the course of GLA University can first apply online on the official website of GLA University and appear for the respective entrance exam to get selected.

faqs.question: What are the courses that GLA University Mathura offers?
faqs.answer: GLA University offers various UG and PG courses in the stream of Engineering, Law, Humanities, Management, Commerce, Law, etc. The popular courses offered at GLA University are BA (Hons), BTech, BBA, BCA, MBA, etc. The university also offers admission to five-year integrated courses such as BA LLB, MBA Integrated and various Lateral Entry courses.

faqs.question: How can I prepare for admission to the BTech CS branch at GLA University?
faqs.answer: At the undergraduate level, GLA University Mathura offers BTech courses to students. The eligibility criteria for the BTech course is Class 12 with a minimum of 50 percent aggregate and the accepted entrance exams areGLAETandCUET. Candidates must prepare well in advance for qualifying these exams as the competition is very high and the seats are limited. The candidates must have a basic knowledge of Science and various other subjects and for the rest, candidates must check the syllabus and then prepare accordingly.

reviews.review_heading: Genuine review from GLA University.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, labs, and classrooms are smart and modern. There is world-class infrastructure in our college. Hostel, food, and rest are all average to decent category. Medical facility is available in the college. Sports and games activity is available on the campus.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the staff and management.
reviews.review_text: Overall, the infrastructure of the college is very good. All labs are equipped with separate Wi-Fi and a firewall to prevent misuse of Wi-Fi. The speed of Wi-Fi is very good. Facilities in the hostel are also very good. The food is given properly, and the health of students is taken care of very responsibly.

reviews.review_heading: Review of GLA University.
reviews.review_text: Our college has good infrastructure. Classrooms are spacious and equipped with projectors and Wi-Fi. Mess food quality is manageable but repetitive, and hygiene is mostly maintained. A medical facility is also available. The central library is well-maintained with a large number of books, journals and digital resources. Hostel facilities are average to good, with clean rooms and basic needs.

reviews.review_heading: Good learning experience with an active campus.
reviews.review_text: The facilities for my course are good. Classrooms are clean and comfortable. Labs are useful for practical work and help us understand subjects better. Wi-Fi is available on campus, and the library has enough books and study material for students. Hostel facilities are okay and suitable for students. Rooms are decent and livable. Mess food is average but clean, and the canteen has different food items. Medical help is available on campus when needed. The college also has good sports facilities f...

reviews.review_heading: GLA University Mathura is a private university. It has many courses, like engineering.
reviews.review_text: GLA University Mathura has good infrastructure with campus Wi-Fi, well-equipped labs, smart classrooms, and a spacious library. Hostels are decent and clean, the mess food is average while medical and sports facilities are easily available and well-maintained.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the faculty, good placements, good infrastructure, and not-so-good facilities.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are fairly good. Every department has its own Wi-Fi, and classrooms are also really well made. Each class has projectors and enough space. The library is also really well made and a nice place to study quietly and peacefully. Talking about the hostel, it also depends on one's adjustment qualities. But the food in the mess is good and sometimes not good too. Canteen food is better tasting than the mess hall food. Medical facilities are average. There is room for impr...

reviews.review_heading: Review of GLA University.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course. They provide us with 24/7 facilities, a modern classroom with a digital board and a projector. Computer labs were working generally. Hostel quality was good. All essential amenities are available on the campus.

reviews.review_heading: Decent placements with good infrastructure, but students must build skills.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is quite good and well maintained. Classrooms are spacious, properly ventilated, and equipped with projectors. Labs for our course are decent with sufficient systems. Wi-Fi is available across the campus and hostels, but the speed may vary at times. The library is large and peaceful. There are two libraries on the campus: one central and one basic. Hostel facilities are satisfactory, with clean rooms and proper security. Mess food quality is average but manageab...

reviews.review_heading: GLA University is good for placements and overall personality growth.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good. The library, labs, and classrooms are fully air-conditioned and well-maintained. Wi-Fi speed on the campus is good. Canteens are hygienic and have a good menu at a good price. Medical facilities are pretty good. There is an ambulance service 24x7. Food in the mess of hostels is good and hygienic. GLA has many football courts, basketball courts, and a cricket ground. Students are encouraged to play sports by the department.

reviews.review_heading: Crowd with the aims and achievements.
reviews.review_text: Faculty members are good at college, provide detailed information about the syllabus and provide content to explore more about the practical implementation, hostels are good in infrastructure and canteens are too good, like malls, you can shop via card.

reviews.review_heading: A good college in terms of fest, events, and college life.
reviews.review_text: In my ECE department, there is hardly any lab missing. Every machine required in our course is present on our campus. Many of my friends live in the hostel, the hostel room quality is very good, but the mess food is below average, and also canteen food is not so good as per the price. Sports facilities are very good.

reviews.review_heading: Good if you want to explore yourself.
reviews.review_text: They are equipped with Wi-Fi, smart board, and electronics labs for practical experience of the theory they are teaching, and hostels have separate ones for first year and for all years, and the menu in all messes is the same, but messes for all hostels are different, and they also have wings.

reviews.review_heading: College has all the facilities, and also the faculty is very helpful.
reviews.review_text: Every department has its own classrooms and labs. Wi-Fi is provided throughout the college campus. Food quality in the canteen is also average. Medical facilities are provided. Sports facilities like basketball court and ground are also provided.

reviews.review_heading: College is awesome. It has a good placement ratio even in the COVID-19 pandemic.
reviews.review_text: Our college has the best infrastructure. It has high internet connectivity. Classrooms are neat and clean. The quality of food is awesome, and it has many different options. There is a clinic in college. There are good playgrounds for playing cricket, athletic games, and basketball. It also has a good sports trainer.

reviews.review_heading: Don't take admission in GLA University.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are okay, but the academic infrastructure is not good. Classes are old, facilities are not up to the mark, and hostel timings are very bad, specifically for girls. Classes get over at 6 pm, and girls' hostel timing is 6:30 pm, while boys' hostel timing is 8 pm. You can't leave the campus after 8, and you can't take parcels and food orders after 10 pm. There are no sports facilities and no extracurricular activities.

reviews.review_heading: Facilities are average, like infrastructure, campus life, crowd, teachers, and hostel.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, library are good. There are all the facilities for a studious student who genuinely wants to study. But the hostel provided for B.Tech students is very bad. No space in the room, no separate almirah, table, chair, or even bed. The food is also very bad at this hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely dissatisfied because of the infrastructure. The faculty is supportive and caring.
reviews.review_text: Benches in classrooms are bad and broken. Fans are not working properly. Hostels are average, and the food is average. The good thing about the college is that it has a very large sports complex, which has many indoor game courts and outdoor sports as well. There is a good library which is very large, and seats are available in very good condition.

reviews.review_heading: Review from 2nd sem B.Tech E&C student.
reviews.review_text: The hostels of the university are in a way like, like you get a hostel in just 1st year, after that, there will be no hostels facility for students and still the hostels are not that good. 4 to5 students live in a single room and it becomes impossible for someone to study.

reviews.review_heading: GJU, Hisar, college life review.
reviews.review_text: There is very good infrastructure that helps us to learn easily. Very good classrooms and smart classes with Wi-Fi for each student are provided in the hostel. The food quality is not very good, but it has good medical facilities and a good sports ground.

reviews.review_heading: A great place for practical learning in printing & packaging.
reviews.review_text: The university has a large campus with greenery and well-maintained buildings. The printing department is equipped with modern labs, offset and flexographic printing machines, computer labs, and a good library. Wi-Fi is available, and classrooms are clean and spacious. Hostel facilities are good, rooms are maintained properly, and the mess food is average but hygienic. Sports facilities, medical centre, canteen and stationery shops are available on campus.

reviews.review_heading: Guru Jambheshwar University of Science and Technology is an overall good university.
reviews.review_text: Basically, there are 4 hostels. Each hostel has Wi-Fi, a canteen, a mess, and TV rooms. There are grounds for playing as well. There are study rooms that are as good as libraries. Medical facilities are also available, as the health center is not far from the hostels.

reviews.review_heading: Our campus is very good in every field, with lots of greenery and best studies.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are very good on our campus, including fully AC labs for new ideas, coding practice, Chemistry lab, AutoCAD lab, and more. Hostels have luxurious rooms and clean washrooms. Mess food is average in hostels, and there are four hostels for girls and four hostels for boys.

reviews.review_heading: Infrastructure is so well. Placement and crowd need to improve if a student is serious about them.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good. Wi-Fi is decent like we get separate Wi-Fi and pass so like you can do your basic work easily. Labs are well-equipped and fully running condition. Library is also AC equipped and fully running well cleaned and big. Quality of students is fine only, like for the first student who got the new hostel, else they will get the old wing that is just average. Quality of food varies to change our meals according to taste. Canteen is available. Medical facility is top notch but...

reviews.review_heading: GJU lifestyle of students.
reviews.review_text: Very neat and clean rooms. I like to spend time with my friends in these classrooms. We talk for hours sitting here, and we always miss this time when we all together sit here and talk to each other and make each other laugh. Sitting in canteen etc. I like it.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2023Offered by Shekhawati Group of InstitutionsReviewed on 27 Oct 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Good institute of the city.
reviews.review_text: There are many facilities on the campus. And all the services provided by the college are the best. The college department is very gentle. There are many facilities like Wi-Fi, Science lab, computer lab, playground, NCC, classroom, off-course, and a big library.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by CRM Jat CollegeReviewed on 23 Oct 2025)
reviews.review_heading: The best college in Haryana
reviews.review_text: My college facilities and infrastructure are very good, and the department is very neat and clean. The classroom is very big and the air facilities are very good. My college hostel facilities and infrastructure are very good, and the food quality is very good.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by Dayanand CollegeReviewed on 14 Oct 2025)
reviews.review_heading: College is moderate with decent campus.
reviews.review_text: There is no Wi-Fi at all. It is only available in computer labs and library. Labs are well furnished and equipped with all the required equipments and materials. Hostel facility is not available for boys but available for girls. There is only a first aid kit in medical facility terms. Sports and games are encouraged. We have dedicated ground and field for specific sports like cricket, football, tennis, handball, etc.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by CRM Jat CollegeReviewed on 9 Oct 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Best college in Haryana.
reviews.review_text: The college facilities and infrastructure are good and the best. The department is very neat and clean. The rooms, labs, library, and classrooms and the hostel facilities are very good, and the food quality is very good. The mess, canteen, medical, and sports facilities are also very good.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2026Offered by CRM Jat CollegeReviewed on 12 Sep 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Best college in Punjab and Haryana.
reviews.review_text: My college facility and infrastructure are very good and the best. Class, library, and labs are very great and air-free rooms, all rooms are neat and clean. My college hostel facilities are very good, and the food quality is very good. My college hostel mess and canteen, medical facilities, sports and games facilities are the best.

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied because of placement and faculty.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure in this college is very good, but it is only the infrastructure, not the study or courses. There is no space in hostels for students, and there is no generator to support electricity after a cut. No one is interested in listening to your problems. You have to buy your light for the room.

paragraphs: Nitte Gulabi Shetty Memorial Institute of Pharmaceutical Sciences admissionis based on merit of the qualifying exam.NGSM Institute of Pharmaceutical Sciencesoffers four courses at undergraduate, postgraduate, diploma and doctoral levels. The college offers courses under theDepartment of Pharmaceutics, Pharmaceutical Chemistry, Pharmacy Practice, Pharmacognosy, Pharmacology & Teaching Hospital. Candidates who meet the course-specific eligibility criteria can apply online for admission through the official website.

NGSM Institute of Pharmaceutical Sciences admissionstypically starts in themonth of April and ends in September, every year. Admission to most of the courses at the college is merit-based. Candidates, however, for all courses are required to meet minimum eligibility criteria to get shortlisted for any and every course offered by NGSM Institute of Pharmaceutical Sciences. The candidates should pass in 10+2 with at least 45% marks in Chemistry, Physics and Biology/Mathematics with English as one of the subjects.

Pass in DPharm course with at least 45% marks.
The candidates should pass the PUC/10+2 with science subjects
Age:Minimum 17 years as of 31st December of the year of admission
Pharm D ( Post Baccalaureate)

The mode of application is online. Interested candidates have to submit an admission query form available on the official website. On receipt of the same, the Admission Section will guide the students through the process of registration and admission.

Admission to all the NGSM Institute of Pharmaceutical Sciences courses is based on merit-secured in the qualifying exam.
Step 3: Admission Confirmation
Once the selection rounds are done, the shortlisted candidates are called for document verification. Aspirants must pay a course fee to confirm their seat in the college.
