hostel_campus.college_name: Nitte Gulabi Shetty Memorial Institute of Pharmaceutical Sciences Infrastructure Details & Reviews

hostel.description: The hostellers are provided with a cot, cupboard, study table and chair. Every hostel has solar water heaters, WiFi facility, common telephone, TV room, reading room, visitors lounge, water coolers, generators, 24x7 security and surveillance cameras. AC rooms are available in some of the hostels. The hostels also have facilities for indoor and outdoor games.
facilities: Library: The institute has a well-stocked library with a large floor area of 3230 sq. ft. It has a rich collection of Printed Books, Back Volumes, W.H.O Publications and CD-ROM. The Library subscribes to National and International journals in print and e-journals and is also a member of the HELINET consortium, DELNET and UpToDate: Evidence-Based Medical decision support service resource. The Library is fully automated with Easylib web version software (ILMS) and computerized through a Bar-coding system. It is also well protected with a fire extinguisher and CCTV surveillance system

Gym: The air-conditioned multi Gymnasium housed in a 5500 sq. ft building is kept open from 6 am to 10 pm for the benefit of students and hostellers. The services of 3 professionally trained instructors are available. Equipment consists of Treadmills, elliptical trainers, exercise bikes, rowing machines and a full-fledged multi-gym.
Shuttle Service: A fleet of buses and vans are maintained on the campus to provide transport facilities to the students and staff, free of cost.
Hospital/Medical Facilities: Students can avail of medical and dental treatment at the 1000-bed multispecialty Justice KS Hegde Charitable Hospital and the A B Shetty Dental College Hospital.

paragraphs: Dibrugarh University offers admission on the basis ofmeritandentrance examscores. The university offers courses in streams like Commerce, Engineering, Social Science, etc. These courses are offered at the undergraduate, post graduate, and doctoral level. It has its own entrance exams likeDUPGET, DURAT, BED CET that are conducted for courses like MA, PhD, and BEd, respectively. Further, the Dibrugarh University accepts entrance exams likeCAT/MAT/CMATandGATE.

Dibrugarh University admissionto courses is either entrance-based or merit-based. The University offers a variety of UG, PG and doctoral-level programmes in the streams ofHumanities & Social Sciences,Science,Commerce,Engineering,Teaching & EducationandMedical & Health Sciences.Dibrugarh Universityoffers most of the UG courses via its affiliated colleges, where admission is merit-based. The university offers PG courses through more than 10 departments and centres of the university. Admission to these courses is done by the university's in-house entrance exams such asDUPGET,DURAT, B.ED CET for MA, PhD, and B.Ed, respectively.For courses such as MBA and MTech, the university accepts valid scores ofCAT/MAT/CMATandGATE, respectively.

Admission to allDibrugarh University courses(UG, PG, diploma and others) is both merit and entrance-based. In the 'Overall' category, the institute's ranks have descended when compared with the previous year's ranking. It has been observed that the institute has displayed stability in trend in the 'University' category as compared to the ranking of preceding years. In 2025, Dibrugarh University's rank is #101, the same as last year's rank in the 'University' category by the NIRF ranking.
In the 'Pharmacy' category, the institute's ranks have descended when compared with the previous year's ranking. reviews.review_heading: Dibrugarh University: Campus and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The facilities here are the green campus, quiet environment, free Wi-Fi for hostelers, hostel facilities, bicycle facilities to roam the university campus, library, park, museums, labs, medical facilities and many more. So the students who wish to come here could come and enjoy the university facilities and their courses.

reviews.review_heading: Dibrugarh University for engineering is good.
reviews.review_text: Library and labs are fine, not bad. Library is air conditioned. Classrooms are big and can accommodate 60 to 70 students. Hostels are average. Food there is also average. Medical facilities are also much better there. They do their work on time only.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2026Offered by Jorhat Kendriya MahavidyalayaReviewed on 6 Nov 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Review of Jorhat Kendriya Mahavidyalaya.
reviews.review_text: We have Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, library, and many more. The hostel in campus only, and they get everything in the college including canteen, rest room, gym, and more to play for mind relaxation. We have medical facilities nearby. Everything is next door.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2029Offered by D.C.B. Girls CollegeReviewed on 24 Sep 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the faculty, value for the money, and everything.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is amazing with lots of benches and a natural pond in the centre. The building is very close to nature, and the departments and classrooms are airy and good. We have an auditorium and a seminar hall for meetings and stuff. Hostel life is good too, but it's too strict, but you can always choose PG.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied because of the faculty, good placements, good infrastructure, facilities, etc.
reviews.review_text: On campus hostel accommodation for both boys & girls, with wardens and support staff. The common university library is accessible, it serves students, faculty and research scholars. It includes course books, reference materials, journals, etc. Several canteens & one cafeteria. A hygienic, modern double-storied cafeteria is located within the institute campus. Also, university-level canteens are shared. Food for students and staff. Wi-Fi & LAN connectivity are available. Well-furnished classrooms...

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available in our department were very good. There are digital classrooms, a big library, labs, and also Wi-Fi connection available in our department as well as the college. The food is also good and hygienic. Don't know much about the hostel, but the canteen is good.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2022Offered by Sonari CollegeReviewed on 6 Sep 2025)
reviews.review_heading: I really like my college. It has good infrastructure facilities etc.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure for our course was quite good. Classrooms were well maintained with projectors air conditioning and comfortable seating. The college provided Wi-Fi computer labs and a central library with a wide range of books and digital resources. Hostel facilities were decent, with spacious rooms 24/7 WiFi laundry services, and common rooms.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2025Offered by Tinsukia CollegeReviewed on 31 Aug 2025)
reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure and facilities are good.
reviews.review_text: The classrooms are good. The college has digital classrooms as well. Hostel quality is also very good, including food and other facilities. Medical facilities are also provided. The canteen is good and clean. Wi-Fi works very well. The library is very big and good.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2025Offered by Dibru CollegeReviewed on 27 Aug 2025)
reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied with my college environment, which has good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure of our college are good and among the best in our locality. We have smart classrooms and a neat and clean environment. Labs are well-maintained and in good condition. The college library has a large collection of books and notes.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2025Offered by Dibru CollegeReviewed on 27 Aug 2025)
reviews.review_heading: I am happy because of the teachers, but disappointed by the placements.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is good. Buildings are large, and the campus is big with department wise classrooms. The auditorium is old, and the chairs are comfortable. The library has a range of books. The canteen has a variety of food. Medical facilities are also available.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2023Offered by Sonari CollegeReviewed on 24 Aug 2025)
reviews.review_heading: 1 quality education- 2 good facilities support.
reviews.review_text: Department has good infrastructure with well-equipped classrooms, a strong library collection (especially in political Science and international relations), computer facilities, and campus Wi-Fi. Hostel facilities were decent, with regular water and electricity supply. Mess food was average but hygienic, and the canteen offered affordable meals. Medical facilities were available on campus, and there were adequate opportunities for sports, cultural activities, and debates.

reviews.review_heading: Opt for B.Tech in ECE only if you are there to have a great college life.
reviews.review_text: I would say the infrastructure was better than most things there, since it was a university. There were various other departments. There was a new central library with three floors but the electronics lab facilities did not match the ones at IITs or tier 1 national colleges, not even close. Hostels seemed reasonable, and the college infrastructure was better than AEC, JEC, and other state government colleges. Giving you a good feel when you are still inside the campus.

faqs.question: What are the career options available after completing a BCom degree course?
faqs.answer: BCom course is the gateway to job opportunities in several fields such as Accounting, Finance, Economics, Taxation, Insurance, etc. One can become an Accountant, Financial Analyst, Auditor, etc. after graduating with a BCom degree. This degree is also beneficial to those students who want to run their own businesses. Because of the variety of work prospects it gives, BCom is one of the most popular undergraduate educational programmes. Commerce is the nation's most important industry, and it has a huge impact on the economy. The expanding economy has resulted in a variety of job opportunities in the business sector. As a result, a Bachelor of Commerce degree can lead to a lucrative career.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Data Analytics) - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: It has good infrastructure, supportive faculty, decent placements, and positive campus life.

review_content.Placements: Around 70 percent of students from my course got placed. The highest package offered is around 10 LPA. The average package offered ranges from 4-5 LPA. Overall, the campus infrastructure is okay, comfortable, and helpful for study and hostel life.

reviews_list.review_title: Mediocre because of no placements or internship opportunities, yet the infrastructure is very good.

review_content.Placements: Around 5-6 students enrolled in the year I took admission. Next year, there were 11-12 students who took admission. There are no placement opportunities or internships provided by our college, which is a huge satisfaction, given that we pay so many fees. There are no recruiting companies that come for placements.
review_content.Infrastructure: There's everything, the classrooms are very spacious, and there are smart boards, there's Wi-Fi, labs, and a library as well, which has plenty of books required for all the departments. The hostels are very clean and tidy. The food is very yummy and also hygienic. You can get all sorts of food, ranging from South Indian to North Indian and even snacks. There's a medical college and a hospital right next to our building, so medical help is always readily available. There are also sports tournaments and club activities that keep happening from time to time. The infrastructure and teaching quality are too good.

reviews_list.batch_info: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2022
reviews_list.review_title: Honest review of my college.

review_content.Placements: We are still in our first year and are the followers of the pilot batch. We have heard companies such as AB and GE have come to place, and a few other industries located in Peenya, with packages of 2.5 to 5 LPA. ABB and GE are a few companies that have selected our seniors. We are still in our first year, so we have just heard it from our seniors. A few companies are giving a stipend of 8000.
review_content.Infrastructure: College food and mess are always pathetic. As per my friends who are staying in the hostel, they have reviewed it as good food in the hostel. However, the college canteen pricing was cheap, but the food quality was not up to the mark.

reviews_list.batch_info: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: MBA course information and admission process at Ramaiah University of Applied Science.

review_content.Placements: Approximately 85% of students are placed. The lowest package is 3 LPA, the highest reached 12 LPA, and the average hovered around 6 LPA. Deloitte, Infosys, TCS, and HDFC Bank are among the recruiters. Finance and consulting firms offered internships. There are fewer tier-1 roles, according to some students.
review_content.Infrastructure: The campus offers robust Wi-Fi, computer labs, smart classrooms, and a well-stocked library. The mess food is mediocre, but the hostel is respectable. There are some, but not many, sports and cultural facilities. Emergency medical care is subpar and could be better.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Automotive Engineering - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: M.Tech and B.Tech Automotive Engineering Course Admission.

review_content.Placements: Approximately 70-75% of the students are placed. The lowest package is 3 LPA, the highest is 12 LPA, and the average is about 5 LPA. Ashok Leyland, Bosch, Mahindra, and Tata Motors were among the top recruiters. Auto factories and R&D companies offered internships, but the core job roles were more restricted than those of IT-based profiles.
review_content.Infrastructure: Practical learning is supported by well-equipped labs, CAD/CAM facilities, and automotive workshops. Classrooms are large, and Wi-Fi is dependable. The mess food is mediocre, but the hostel is decent. There are some sports facilities, but not many. Although it could be more timely, medical care is adequate.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Computational Social Science - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Absolutely satisfied within a year with great facilities and good infrastructure.

review_content.Placements: A lot of roles are offered in very high-verified job sites, like the companies TCS, Infosys, IBM, Amazon, and also Google, with an average salary package depending on the department, but in a range of 4-7 LPA, with the highest domestic package reaching up to 52 LPA.
review_content.Infrastructure: The food and infrastructure are top-notch, except for the Wi-Fi issues. I am not using any hostel right now, but based on what I heard, this is the thing they face; they have a proper curfew and good food, which properly provides the needed nutrients.

reviews_list.batch_info: M.Pharm. in Pharmacology - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: My honest review of my college.

review_content.Placements: Since I was from the first batch, the placements were comparatively good compared to other colleges with their first passing batches. Although major companies didn't show up, the package ranged between 3–7 LPA across all branches. The placement rate was around 65%.
review_content.Infrastructure: The hostel was well-equipped with all major facilities such as Wi-Fi, showers, etc. Shared rooms were available (2 in 1 room). Each room had a chair and study table for each student, along with separate cupboards. The fees were Rs.45,000 per year, and the mess fees were around Rs.4,000 a month. The food quality was a total disaster. My advice would be to take a flat outside the campus and have good food. University hostel facilities in both the Peenya campus and the Gangotri campus had good rooms, and good food was provided there.

review_summary.college_name: MS Ramaiah University of Applied Sciences Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Discontinued(Dec 2025)- B.Sc. (Hons.) in Economics - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Mediocre because of no placements or internship opportunities, yet the infrastructure is very good.

content.Placements: Around 5-6 students enrolled in the year I took admission. Next year, there were 11-12 students who took admission. There are no placement opportunities or internships provided by our college, which is a huge satisfaction, given that we pay so many fees. There are no recruiting companies that come for placements.
content.Infrastructure: There's everything, the classrooms are very spacious, and there are smart boards, there's Wi-Fi, labs, and a library as well, which has plenty of books required for all the departments. The hostels are very clean and tidy. The food is very yummy and also hygienic. You can get all sorts of food, ranging from South Indian to North Indian and even snacks. There's a medical college and a hospital right next to our building, so medical help is always readily available. There are also sports tournaments and club activities that keep happening from time to time. The infrastructure and teaching quality are too good.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Honest review of my college.

content.Placements: We are still in our first year and are the followers of the pilot batch. We have heard companies such as AB and GE have come to place, and a few other industries located in Peenya, with packages of 2.5 to 5 LPA. ABB and GE are a few companies that have selected our seniors. We are still in our first year, so we have just heard it from our seniors. A few companies are giving a stipend of 8000.
content.Infrastructure: College food and mess are always pathetic. As per my friends who are staying in the hostel, they have reviewed it as good food in the hostel. However, the college canteen pricing was cheap, but the food quality was not up to the mark.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: MBA course information and admission process at Ramaiah University of Applied Science.

content.Placements: Approximately 85% of students are placed. The lowest package is 3 LPA, the highest reached 12 LPA, and the average hovered around 6 LPA. Deloitte, Infosys, TCS, and HDFC Bank are among the recruiters. Finance and consulting firms offered internships. There are fewer tier-1 roles, according to some students.
content.Infrastructure: The campus offers robust Wi-Fi, computer labs, smart classrooms, and a well-stocked library. The mess food is mediocre, but the hostel is respectable. There are some, but not many, sports and cultural facilities. Emergency medical care is subpar and could be better.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Computational Social Science - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied within a year with great facilities and good infrastructure.

content.Placements: A lot of roles are offered in very high-verified job sites, like the companies TCS, Infosys, IBM, Amazon, and also Google, with an average salary package depending on the department, but in a range of 4-7 LPA, with the highest domestic package reaching up to 52 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The food and infrastructure are top-notch, except for the Wi-Fi issues. I am not using any hostel right now, but based on what I heard, this is the thing they face; they have a proper curfew and good food, which properly provides the needed nutrients.

individual_reviews.course: M.Pharm. in Pharmacology - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: My honest review of my college.

content.Placements: Since I was from the first batch, the placements were comparatively good compared to other colleges with their first passing batches. Although major companies didn't show up, the package ranged between 3–7 LPA across all branches. The placement rate was around 65%.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel was well-equipped with all major facilities such as Wi-Fi, showers, etc. Shared rooms were available (2 in 1 room). Each room had a chair and study table for each student, along with separate cupboards. The fees were Rs.45,000 per year, and the mess fees were around Rs.4,000 a month. The food quality was a total disaster. My advice would be to take a flat outside the campus and have good food. University hostel facilities in both the Peenya campus and the Gangotri campus had good rooms, and good food was provided there.

admission_process.title: MS Ramaiah University of Applied Sciences Admission Process 2026

paragraphs: MSRUAS admission processconsists of multiple steps. It includes applying online to RUASAT for entrance-based admission or registering for direct admission. More details aroundM.S. Ramaiah University of Applied Sciences admission processare as follows:
Application Process

MSRUAS application process is conducted in online mode. Candidates can apply on the official website for their desired programme. An application fee of INR 2000 needs to be paid through online gateway.
Selection Process

Students are shortlisted based on entrance exams for all of the courses except for the BVoc programme. The university conducts RUAS-AT for admission to the remaining programmes. Alternatively, valid scores of other national-level exams including CUET/ NEET/ JEE or state-level exams - KCET/ COMEDK are also accepted,
Counselling Process & Document Verification

After the completion of all the selection rounds, candidates are offered seats through common counselling process. Candidates who get selected must download and fill an admission form on the university's official website. After filling the form, candidates need to pay a tuition fee and submit documents at the university for the verification.

MS Ramaiah University of Applied Sciences fee structuremay include components such as tuition fees, library fees, lab fees, caution deposit, etc. Some elements are to be paid only once, while the remaining are charged yearly or semesterly. The fee range includes multiple specialisations. The seat intake may change every academic year. There's a medical college and a hospital right next to our building, so medical help is always readily available. There are also sports tournamen...

reviews.review_heading: Honest review of my college.
reviews.review_text: College food and mess are always pathetic. As per my friends who are staying in the hostel, they have reviewed it as good food in the hostel. However, the college canteen pricing was cheap, but the food quality was not up to the mark.

reviews.review_heading: MBA course information and admission process at Ramaiah University of Applied Science.
reviews.review_text: The campus offers robust Wi-Fi, computer labs, smart classrooms, and a well-stocked library. The mess food is mediocre, but the hostel is respectable. There are some, but not many, sports and cultural facilities. Emergency medical care is subpar and could be better.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2026Offered by Faculty of Engineering and Technology, M.S. Ramaiah University of Applied SciencesReviewed on 22 Aug 2025)
reviews.review_heading: M.Tech and B.Tech Automotive Engineering Course Admission.
reviews.review_text: Practical learning is supported by well-equipped labs, CAD/CAM facilities, and automotive workshops. Classrooms are large, and Wi-Fi is dependable. The mess food is mediocre, but the hostel is decent. There are some sports facilities, but not many. Although it could be more timely, medical care is adequate.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied within a year with great facilities and good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The food and infrastructure are top-notch, except for the Wi-Fi issues. I am not using any hostel right now, but based on what I heard, this is the thing they face; they have a proper curfew and good food, which properly provides the needed nutrients.

reviews.review_heading: My honest review of my college.
reviews.review_text: The hostel was well-equipped with all major facilities such as Wi-Fi, showers, etc. Shared rooms were available (2 in 1 room). Each room had a chair and study table for each student, along with separate cupboards. The fees were  Rs.45,000 per year, and the mess fees were around Rs.4,000 a month. The food quality was a total disaster. My advice would be to take a flat outside the campus and have good food. University hostel facilities in both the Peenya campus and the Gangotri campus had good roo...

reviews.review_heading: My honest review of my college.
reviews.review_text: Hostels provided single and shared rooms, with prices ranging from Rs.35,000 to Rs.60,000 per room, including electricity charges. Food was not included.

reviews.review_heading: My review about this college.
reviews.review_text: Hostel rooms were good as my friend resides in the hostel. I used to go to his room in my free time. Room was shared as 2 students were residing in a room. There were separate things for both students in a room like a wardrobe, bed, table, and 2 chairs. College had PG named 555-PG. Mess fee was Rs 4,000 for every month which included breakfast, lunch, snacks, and dinner.

reviews.review_heading: My review about this college.
reviews.review_text: It's good as it has a hostel inside the college with all live home facilities where it's been provided with a gym, yoga, sports room, club room, and party room. Each room is provided with a self-system for the students living for their usage, food is good and they provide to your room 3 times a day. This course is meant for me to join the top companies in which the Ramaiah has been liked with that companies and they are giving very good facilities to the students. My dream is to become a very go...

reviews.review_heading: It has an environment to find minded people and grow with part of difficulties and blockades.
reviews.review_text: We have special rooms for boys and girls known as a sac with an in-built gym and other board games as well. There is a ground for football, cricket, and indoor courts as well. The hostel is average with okay food. It has a 3-star hostel. Timings are preferred for students.

reviews.review_heading: There are no placements yet by the college, but it's a great experience to learn the course.

Labs are well-equipped, and classrooms have interactive boards to help us with our academics and course understanding. There is a huge park, wide corridors, a huge food street, and good parking facilities.

reviews.review_heading: A brief review of Ramaih College of Pharmacy.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is the main highlight of the college. The campus is vast comprising 13 different faculty members like engineering, medical, dental, etc. Wi-Fi is available throughout the college, labs are equipped with all the necessary instruments and chemicals. Classes are high-teach comprising smartboard speakers, and comfortable seats for individual students. The library is on the third floor where all the required books are available we can get them for 3 or 15 days. The hostel i...

reviews.review_heading: A college that everyone should check out. It has a really good faculty and a big, beautiful campus.
reviews.review_text: Facilities wise, it is really great. Classrooms have Wi-Fi, and each table has separate charging ports for laptops or mobile phones. There are projectors, speakers, and more. The campus has a vast library, places to relax, an indoor sports complex, and other amenities. The quality of the hostel is good, and more hostels are being built. The food is also good and of high quality.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty members are good overall.

paragraphs: Sharda University admissions to its School of Pharmacy are done via SUSAT or JEE/CET/CLAT/LSAT/CAT/MAT/XAT/NATA/NEET/CUET scores. The admission process begins with applying for the entrance exam. Find below the completeSchool of Pharmacy, Sharda University admission process2025:
Step 1: SOP Sharda University Application Process 2025

For SOP, Sharda University course admissions, the first step is to fill out an online application form. Aspirants who apply via SUAT are required to visit the official website of Sharda University to apply for the course and book a slot for the SUAT exam. They also have to pay an application fee of INR 1,500 for male and INR 1,000 for female candidates.
Step 2: SOP Selection Rounds

Candidates can either get admission via the SUAT or CUET UG exams. Aspirants are required to qualify for any of the respective exams with a valid score. Further, they also have to appear for a PI round conducted by the School of Pharmacy, Sharda University.
Step 3: SOP Counselling Process

The university will shortlist candidates based on their past academic records, entrance exam scores & PI round performance. The university will release the list of selected candidates and a provisional admission will be offered to those candidates.
Step 4: Fee Submission & Documents Verification

The selected candidates will be required to pay the course fee via Cash/ DD/ Credit-Debit Card or through Online payment. Shortlisted aspirants need to come for document verification and pay theSOP Sharda University feeto confirm their seats at the institute.

reviews.review_heading: Review of School of Pharmacy, Sharda University.
reviews.review_text: Our college facilities are well-equipped, and our college is very supportive of all kinds of problems. The infrastructure of our college was very good. reviews.review_heading: All is good in the college.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of faculty, good placements in 2015, and really good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The campus is very good. Campus life is very good, with a big and beautiful park. Wi-Fi is available everywhere. Sports and games are also available, like badminton, basketball, and cricket. The mess food is good, the canteen is clean and big, and it is cost-friendly. The mess is clean. Admission to these courses is based on either the scores of entrance exams specified by the University or the merit list prepared by the Admission Committee for Professional Courses (ACPC). There is the provision of a 10% relaxation in eligibility criteria for the reserved category in GTU.

The main selection body for Gujarat Technological University admission is the Admission Committee for Professional Courses (ACPC). The admission procedure for Gujarat Technological University involves multiple steps, such as appearing for the accepted entrance exam, application, selection, counselling, and admission confirmation. Students seeking admission must fulfil all of the required admission criteria before applying. Candidates have to qualify for all the rounds of the selection process. Find below the detailed GTUadmissions process:
Step 1: Gujarat Technological University Application Process 2025

Gujarat Technological University's admission processstarts with the application process. Candidates can download the application process from the university's official website. The duly filled application form has to be sent either through post or submitted in person at the concerned department at GTU. However, the application and entrance test fee will be paid online and candidates have to attach the pay slip along with the two copies of the online bank challan with the application form.
Step 2: Selection Rounds

Admission to all the PG courses at Gujarat Technological University is entrance-based. Candidates have to qualify for either university-level or state-level entrance exams such asJUCET, and JEEMain for the selection of respective courses. Furthermore, the university offers UG courses through its affiliated colleges. Admissions to UG courses are based on merit scores obtained in the last qualifying exam.
Step 3: Merit List Release & Counselling

After the completion of all the selection rounds, candidates have to appear for the counselling process for the respective courses. Later on, the university will release the merit list in various rounds of the selected candidates. Students who find their names on the merit list need to pay a certain amount of fee to secure their seats.

faqs.question: Are admissions at Gujarat Technological University entrance-based or merit-based?
faqs.answer: Gujarat Technological University (GTU) admissions are primarily through ACPC, following entrance tests such as GUJCET or JEE for undergraduate studies and GATE or CMAT for postgraduation. Direct admissions are not generally permitted, with the exception of the management quota in affiliated institutions. Diploma students can apply for lateral entry to the second year of particular courses. If you’re considering direct admission, it’s best to check the policies for your desired programme and college. For courses like BCA, BBA and BVoc admission is based on merit.

faqs.question: Is Gujarat Technological University entrance exam hard?
faqs.answer: The difficulty of the entrance exams for Gujarat Technological University (GTU), like GUJCET and JEE Main, really depends on your preparation and the course you're aiming for. GUJCET is generally considered to be of moderate difficulty, covering Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics.

faqs.question: How can candidates join Gujarat Technological University?
faqs.answer: GTU offers admission through online mode. Students willing to get admission in any course at GTU should visit the official website of the institute. The university grants admission on the basis of merit & entrance both. Some national-level examinations are accepted by the university for admission to a few courses such as GATE, CMAT, JEE Main etc.UG offers various courses including B.E, B.Tech, and B.Pharma. To be eligible, students need to complete 10+2 level with at least 50% marks from a recognised board and qualify JEE Main or GUJCET.The PG domain requires a Bachelor's degree with minimum percentage and admission is based on entrance test marks, with merit-based admission for some courses.For the Doctoral courses, the institute offers PhD, M.Phil, Pharm.D courses in multiple specialisations. faqs.question: Is pursuing MBA at Gujarat Technological University expensive?

content.Placements: In the session of 2024-25, there are 75% students got placements in CSE in startup and non-technical companies. Labs are well-equipped with modern computers, machines, and tools.

1: Punjabi University Application Process
Aspirants have to fill out the application form for the preferred course on the university's website. Candidates need to pay an application fee and upload the documents to submit the form.
2: Selection
The university accepts JEE Main for BTech and GATE for MTech. The selection for most of the other courses based on merit.
3: Counselling and Admission Confirmation

Selected aspirants have to further participate in the counselling rounds. The seats are allotted to candidates based on their merit or entrance exam scores. Aspirants have to pay the course fee to confirm their seat in the university.

faqs.answer: Punjabi University, Patiala, has kept up its spree of winning the highestA grade on a four-point scaleamongst over 350 universities in the country. faqs.question: What is the fee for BSc at Punjabi University?
faqs.answer: The total tuition fee for BSc Programmes offered at Punjabi University is between INR 8,060 to INR 4.80 lakh. Punjabi University offers BSc In various specialisations. The duration of the course is 3 years. Candidates who wish to take admission to these courses should fulfil the basic eligibility criteria. The basic criteria are that Candidate should have passed Class 12 with at least 50% marks in aggregate in any discipline. Punjabi University admissions are offered on the basis of merit in the qualifying examination and for some courses marks obtained in the entrance examination. The university conducts an interview for admission to every course.

faqs.question: What is the fee for BA course at Punjabi University Patiala?
faqs.answer: The total tuition fee for BA Courses is between INR 25,560 to INR 4.12 Lacs. Punjabi University offers BA. In various fields of Humanities and Languages. Candidates who wish to take admission to these courses should fulfil the basic eligibility criteria. The basic criteria are that Candidate should have passed Class 12 with at least 50 percent marks in aggregate in any discipline. National-level tests such as the CAT (Common Admission Test), MAT (Management Aptitude Test), XAT (Xavier Aptitude Test), CMAT (Common Management Admission Test), and any other test that is comparable and accepted by the university may be included in this category.Entrance Exam unique to the University: For MBA admissions, SPMVV may administer an entrance exam of its own. Prospective applicants may inquire about the eligibility requirements and whether SPMVV administers a separate entrance exam for MBA admissions by visiting the university's official website or admission booklet.Direct Admission: Depending on the applicant's educational background, professional background, and other requirements set forth by the university, SPMVV may occasionally provide direct admission to MBA programs.

reviews.review_heading: Good and nice college for me.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure are available in our college for our department, including good Wi-Fi connections and very high-end computers. We have a big space in the labs. The classrooms are very good, and the library is useful. Mess is good and neat.

reviews.review_heading: Great placements, supportive faculty, and excellent campus life with modern facilities.
reviews.review_text: Our department has Wi-Fi, advanced labs, smart classrooms, and a well stocked library. Hostel offers clean rooms, good mess and canteen food, medical support, and ample sports facilities for games, ensuring a balanced academic and campus life. All facilities are available in my campus.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with my college, and their communication with students is excellent.
reviews.review_text: Everything is perfect about my course, but sometimes the hostel food is not good. The hostel accommodation is clean and neat. The hostel is not a jail, it's equal to a home, and it has a warm and inviting atmosphere. A secure environment measure is in place to protect residents.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has a placement cell.
reviews.review_text: In my college labs are available for doing practical work. The college provides Wi-Fi to the students. Classrooms are very clean and pleasant. There is a playground, canteen, and also a hospital in my college. The food is very delicious in our hostel.

reviews.review_heading: According to college it is good, but placements are not upto the mark last year but it is better now
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, labs, and all are available with good infrastructure. The library is separate for B. Tech students on the campus itself. In hostels, Wi-Fi is available, but we have to adjust according to the food provided in the mess. Coming to hostels, they are good, but we have to maintain them.

reviews.review_heading: It is a great college with great facilities.
reviews.review_text: The college has good facilities and infrastructure for students. The college campus has a good environment, separate workshops, buildings, etc. It provides facilities like free Wi-Fi, good labs, and classrooms. The library is useful to students. It also has multiple sports grounds.

reviews.review_heading: Good faculty, placement are growing gradually and campus life is very interesting.
reviews.review_text: In the college and hostel, we have 24/7 free Wi-Fi available, and the labs are efficient. Sanitation is maintained properly. We have a physical health care center available anytime, a yoga center, a sports club, etc. We have an open ground for sports, including an indoor auditorium.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure, but it would be better if they brought more placements for this year.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides various infrastructural facilities like a hostel, cafeteria, library with a wide range of collections, etc. The university also provides ATM facilities, an indoor stadium, and a gym to the students. The quality of all these facilities mentioned above is of utmost quality, and the food in the mess and canteen is very good, especially the breakfast provided in the morning. They have various sports accessories like balls, shuttlecocks, nets, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely, it's a great university with all the facilities that are helpful to students .
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is very good. The facilities they provide are awesome. In our department we have Wi-Fi, library, classrooms moot court, etc. In our hostel, we also have a Wi-Fi facility, beds, etc. They will provide with games, music, and extra curricular activities.

reviews.review_heading: College life at SPMVV, Tirupati, is excellent.
reviews.review_text: The facilities they are providing are good; there are a wide range of labs and classrooms and good infrastructure; there are two libraries in the college; full Wi-Fi is available in the college; the quality of food and hostel facilities is medium; there is a ground in the college to play; yoga classes are available in the morning; and there is also a small medical hospital in the college; they provide tables and all.

reviews.review_heading: Except food, everything is good.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is too good. As we have adjusted for food, it is not up to the mark. Wi-Fi is available in the college and hostels. Medical facilities are available. Sports are also encouraged here; they also encourage people to participate in the tournaments and South Zone competitions too.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides good teachers but the food served in the mess is not good.
reviews.review_text: Our campus is Wi-Fi enabled. There is a decent library in this college. Library cards are given to all students at this university. We can borrow books from the library for 30 days. Our campus is eco-friendly. The food served in the mess is very good. Canteen is available. Medical facilities are very good.

reviews.review_heading: Neither satisfactory but nor too bad.
reviews.review_text: There are several blocks for hostel. We can't expect which block will be given for B.Tech. Some block are good but some are very bad, even without sunlight. In hostel, food is completely veg. Taste is very bad. Better to take outside hostels. But the college hostel charge an average of 2.7k INR per month.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with our supportive teachers.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides Wi-Fi to students. Our college has a digital laboratory to download books or journals for research projects. We have a central library through which we can gain knowledge of all topics. Our classrooms are good.

reviews.review_heading: Our college had good placements in 2022 and non-vegetarian food is available.
reviews.review_text: The frequency of Wi-Fi is low. The library is good and all types of books are available. Medical facilities are good and interested members can join sports. Our hostel building is too old so facilities are fewer in our hostel. Our college does not serve non-vegetarian food, and some hostels do not have a proper network.

overview_faqs.question: What is the procedure for withdrawal at VELS University?
overview_faqs.answer: Before Commencement of Program: Application for withdrawal from the programis to be sent to the Admission Office.After Commencement of Program: Application for withdrawal from the programis to be submitted to the Registrar through the respective department. The application willbe processed within 15 days. There shall not be any fee at the time of submittingapplication. A candidate who wishes to withdraw from the Institute after enrolling in the program must obtain a 'No Dues' Certificate from their respective school of study at VISTAS in order to retrieve their certificates.This should be accompanied by the application for withdrawal duly signed by the Parent/Guardian and the original fee receipt and provisional admissionletter ( e-mail request will not be considered ).The certificates will be issued only on production of the 'No-Dues' Certificate in the prescribedform, obtained from the Admissions Office.

overview_faqs.question: What is the fee refund policy of VELS University?
overview_faqs.answer: Candidates wan to cancel their admission are eligible for refund of academic fee. The refund will be made as per the norms of UGC. The university doen't refund the admission and registration fee. Request for cancellation of admission and refund of fees may be considered in accordance with the following norms:If a candidates applies for cancellation prior to the commencement of classes, then, thetuition fee will be refunded. Registration and admission fees are not refundable.If a candidates discontinues in the middle of a course, he / she shall be required to paythe tuition fee for the remaining period of the programme.The management may sympathetically consider the application to discontinue andon their discretion may order for the payment of tuition fee for the semester duringwhich the student has last attended and permit to issue to TC.

review_summary.college_name: VELS University Chennai Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Reality of so called reputed university.

content.Placements: Placements are pretty mediocre at their best, only 30 percent of students get placed mainly in software based companies and we do not have proof that we ever have a product based company for placements. The roles offered are pretty basic and only very few get the opportunity for internship.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is below average. You get pretty slow Wi-Fi in campuses, classrooms are cleaned once a week, medical facilities are not free and they are very expensive if it is an emergency too and the hostel is fine there is nothing too fancy or bad, but the food is bad.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Microbiology - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Satisfied with the faculty, infrastructure could be improved, and good placements last year.

content.Placements: I just joined my batch a few months ago. I don’t know the placement percentage, but there are 63 students enrolled in my course. I also don’t know the package system yet. The recruiting companies for my course are SYASANS and ZOHO, and the top roles are Senior Microbiologist and Lab Technician.
content.Infrastructure: The whole college is divided into particular blocks for certain courses. Some newly built blocks are very comfortable, but the block I am in, the first building made, is honestly not the ideal block to have classrooms in. I come from Lucknow, and it is sort of difficult for me at the start, but now I have adjusted to hostel life. It has been a hard journey, but overall, the hostel is good.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. LL.B. (Hons.) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Good faculty and better studies.

content.Placements: Legal side roles are offered in limited companies only. The highest package for my course is more than 1 lakh per semester. 100% of students are placed in my course. We have three sections in each batch. Top recruiters are Zoho Corporation, HDFC Bank, and other companies.
content.Infrastructure: We have labs, a moot court hall, classroom projectors, and a library for our course. The quality of food is okay but not very hygienic. They provide both veg and non-veg from the same canteen, and a medical room is available. Sports and games are conducted every semester in our college.

The university conducts its own VELS Scholarship Admission Test (V-SAT) to provide scholarship admission to 60+ UG courses. Additionally, the university also accepts national-level entrance exams like CAT, MAT, XAT, GATE, etc., for admission to MBA and MTech courses, respectively. VELS University offers courses at UG, PG and PhD levels through different schools. paragraphs: VELS University admission involves application, selection, and admission confirmation. The admission criteria begin with the release of the application form. Check below the step-wiseVELS University admission process:
Application Process
Students can apply online directly through the official application portal of VELS University.
Selection Rounds

VELS University admission 2026 is purely merit-based and is determined by the marks obtained in the 12th standard for the respective courses. However, for law courses, the university also conducts a personal interview as part of the selection process. The university conducts its ownVELS Scholarship Admission Test(V-SAT) to provide scholarship admission to 60+ UG courses. Further, direct admission is offered to BSc and MSc courses based on candidates' scores obtained in the last qualifying exams.
Final Admission
After the completion of all the selection rounds, the selected students may pay a certain amount of course fee to confirm admission.

faqs.question: Will I get a fee refund if I cancel my LLM admission from VELS University?
faqs.answer: Yes, VELS University does provide a refund in case of withdrawal of admission. However, the refund is subject to fulfillment of certain conditions. Listed below are the guidelines to be followed as per the fee refund policy of the university: If students apply for cancellation prior to the commencement of classes, then they are entitled to a refund of the tuition fees. In such a case, registration and admission fees are not refundable. If a student discontinues in the middle of a course, he/she shall be required to pay the tuition fee for the remaining period of the programme.

hostel_campus.college_name: VELS University Chennai Infrastructure Details & Reviews

hostel.description:
VISTAS offers residential accommodation for more than 1,000 students within the campus premises. The University houses Ten hostels (AC and NON AC Hostels) 5 Boys Hostel, 3 Girls Hostel a NRI Hostel and an International Students’ Hostel — providing a safe, inclusive, and multicultural living environment.
Rooms are available on a shared basis (2 to 4occupants) with all essential amenities, including air-conditioned options. The hostels have spacious dining halls serving multi-cuisine meals (both vegetarian and non-vegetarian) prepared in hygienic conditions.

library.description:
VELS Institute of Science, Technology and Advanced Studies has a fully automated central library with a seating capacity of 500 persons and follows Open Access System. The library has a collection of 114305 books, 137717 e-books, and 10032 back volumes. It has the subscription of more than 359 Periodicals (National & International), more than 12381 e-journals, 4106 dissertations, 4849 audio-visual resources.
It also facilitates access to e-journals from IEEE/IEL, ASME, ASCE, EBSCO, ProQuest, BENTHAM Science Pharmacy, Micromedex’s Drugdex System, Inventi Online, Nature Online, Law finder, NPTEL etc.
The library is also an associate member of Madras Library Network (MALIBNET) and Institutional member British Council Library.

reviews_list.review_title: My review about this college.

review_content.Placements: Placement is good enough. High reputed companies placement opportunities. More than 300+ companies including MNCs visited us last year for recruiting us. The average salary package offered is 5.0 LPA, and the highest last year is 17 LPA, which is a good number. Top recruiting companies like Wipro, Infosys, Mahindra, Accenture, TCS, Byju's, and HDFC Bank visited our campus for placements. Software engineer role is offered to the students. Nearly 70 percent of students got an internship in different companies. Different levels of interviews and tests on skill-based packages are conducted.

reviews_list.review_title: Review of Amity University, Gurugram.

review_content.Placements: 45% placement with 15-30 Lacs pachage. 98% student passed the college. In amity the highest package was 67 Lacs and the lowest package was 20 Lacs. Ghe top recruiting companies for my course was google and more. 69% student got internship from my course in google and more big companies .
review_content.Infrastructure: The hostels are in very good condition. Very good facilities and infrastructure are available for your course and department; for example, Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and a library are all very good. The quality of the facilities in hostels is very good. The quality of food is also very good.

reviews_list.batch_info: MBA in Advertising and Public Relations - Batch of 2023
reviews_list.review_title: My review of this college.

review_content.Placements: Amity offers all eligible candidates the opportunity to get placed in MNCs. Amity provides both internships and placements. Mostly, all students are placed. It invites various companies to visit the campus for pre-placement talks, to share requirements for vacant positions, and handpick students for the best-suited roles. Amity University offers 100% placements for its students. Some of the big names include Amazon, Think & Learn, Zycus, ITS, Aditya Birla, Coca-Cola, etc. The average package offered to students is 3.25 LPA. The highest package offered last year was 22 LPA.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Amity University Gurgaon B.Tech CSE review.

review_content.Placements: I am pursuing B.Tech in CSE from Amity University, Haryana. In our current batch 2025, many students who appeared for placement have relevant skills get placed in their placement session. The highest package is around 15 LPA above, and the lowest package is around 3 LPA - 4 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Capgemini, TCS, Yamaha, and many startups. Role offered is software developer.
review_content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure at Amity is good with very calm environment. There are many active clubs and societies you and become part of those and explore yourself. You can also make a good connection here. There are only few places where you can get Wi-Fi. Library is one of them and college classrooms are air-conditioned. Hostel is overall good with good facilities for hostel mess. There are 2 messes at Amity and many other outlets for food. Amity has a very big sports complex timing is 1:00 PM - 2:00 PM only.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Sc. in Nursing - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Amity University is considered as a good university for studies.

review_content.Placements: 100% of students got placed in this course. The average salary is 3 LPA to 5 LPA. Medanta, Fortis, Gangaram, and Narayana are the recruiting hospitals. 100% of students got internships from our course at Medanta, Fortis, Gangaram, Narayana, etc. Top role offered in our course is nursing officer.
review_content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, library, and all are available. Infrastructure is very good. Facilities in hostel and course are good including food of the best quality. Medical facilities are available with doctors and nurses. We have good sports ground and different games.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Sc. in Nursing - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Amazing procedures and life-size equipments to get a thorough knowledge of nursing.

review_content.Placements: Approximately 80-85% of the students are placed in my senior year while they are still attending classes, and with a very decent and respectful package. Recruiting companies like Medanta, Fortis, Paras, and Sri Gangaram Hospital. We have a 6-month internship in the last semester in a community setting at Medanta and Civil Hospital, Gurugram. Top roles offered are staff nurse, operation theatre nurse, and availability to higher courses.
review_content.Infrastructure: We have atleast 4-5 different labs catering to each department and having human size models, dummies, and equipments. All the procedures and equipments to perform and practice for the future. Our hostel is a very safe and secure place having sets of 2 beds in each room, 6 students in each suite. For food, we have at least 7 different places with amazing food and a way to connect to people. Medical facilities are available 24X7. Sports events and cultural fests happen twice a year.

paragraphs: Amity University Gurgaon admission is a multi-step process. Candidates seeking for getting admission to various courses of the university must apply at the official website. To admit the right candidates, the university selects students based on selection criteria, which include filling out the application form, qualifying for the selection rounds and paying for the Amity University Gurugram fees at the time of final admission.
Step 1: Amity University Gurgaon Application Process 2025

Students must fill out an application form on the official admission website of Amity University Gurugram (https://portal.amity.edu/NewOnlineForm/Candidate/SignUp). With candidates needing to fill out a separate form in case of multiple course by paying an application fee ofINR 1,100for each form. The new users are required to generate login credentials and fill out an online application form with all the relevant details and documents and submit the form on the admission portal of Amity University Gurgaon.
Step 2: Amity University Gurgaon Selection Process

Amity University Gurgaon admissions are both merit and entrance-based. For most of the UG & PG courses, candidates are selected based on merit of the last qualifying exam of previous education. Further, the shortlisted candidates have to appear for the Personal Interview round as per course requirements. The students are selected based on Amity PhD Entrance Test +Interview by Faculty Member or All India National Level Competitive Examination or NET (viz. UGC / CSIR -NET in Category 1,2 or 3, ICMR- JRF/SRF, ICAR-AICE-JRF/SRF (PhD),GATE, GPAT, DST – INSPIRE, DBT-JRF etc.
Step 3: Final Offer Letter

The final results are declared after the completion of all previous rounds. The information concerning selection will be communicated on the admission microsite as well as via Email and SMS. Selected candidates will get an admission letter along with important information such as semester fee, class commencement date, time, venue of the course, allotment of a hostel (If applied), scholarship (If any) and the list of documents required at the time of joining. Candidates also have to pay a certain amount as per theAmity University Gurugram feesstructure to secure their seats.

hostel.description:
Amity University provides air-conditioned apartment-style accommodation facility for 2100 students. The rooms are well-lit and well-ventilated, with geysers in every bathroom and TV set in the common room for entertainment.

The separate facilities for boys and girls, caring wardens and a tight security ensure a pleasant stay allowing students to focus on their academics. The air-conditioned residential apartment suites consist of 3 single rooms with an attached bathroom and sitting lounge equipped necessary furniture.

library.description:
Amity University library is an integrated knowledge resource centre that is stocked with approx 50,000 books, 20,000 journals and 2,500 publications. 

Amity students have access to Ebsco Host, UGC-Infonet, INDEST-AICTE, IS1 and Delnet. All Amity students are members of Amizone - Amity Intranet Zone which allows them easy access to these journals and papers.

These Libraries consist of Reference Sections, Circulation Sections, Audio-visual Sections, Periodical Sections and Digital Libraries.

reviews.review_heading: My review about this college.
reviews.review_text: Course curriculum is pretty appropriate, especially for students belonging to an IT background. First two semesters covered the basics of languages like C, C+. Later we learned about some advanced languages like Java, HTML, etc. There re a lot of guest lectures and workshops which are frequently organized for knowledge. Hostel facility is available and also PGs are available near the college. The room offering is good with single as well as double sharing, and the price of separate rooms is high...

reviews.review_heading: Review of Amity University, Gurugram.
reviews.review_text: The hostels are in very good condition. Very good facilities and infrastructure are available for your course and department; for example, Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and a library are all very good. The quality of the facilities in hostels is very good. The quality of food is also very good.

reviews.review_heading: My review of this college.
reviews.review_text: It is great. The hostel is very comfortable with a friendly atmosphere everywhere. Students taking the AC hostel are given separate rooms with an almirah. For a non-AC hostel, the same things are given, but instead of separate rooms for students. They are given 3 sharing and 2 sharing rooms. The food quality is really good in the mess. The campus has many food outlets, which leaves no doubt in getting good food for hostellers and day scholars as well.

reviews.review_heading: Amity University Gurgaon B.Tech CSE review.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure at Amity is good with very calm environment. There are many active clubs and societies you and become part of those and explore yourself. You can also make a good connection here. There are only few places where you can get Wi-Fi. Library is one of them and college classrooms are air-conditioned. Hostel is overall good with good facilities for hostel mess. There are 2 messes at Amity and many other outlets for food. Amity has a very big sports complex timing is 1:00 PM - 2:00 PM o...

reviews.review_heading: Amity University is considered as a good university for studies.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, library, and all are available. Infrastructure is very good. Facilities in hostel and course are good including food of the best quality. Medical facilities are available with doctors and nurses. We have good sports ground and different games.

reviews.review_heading: Amazing procedures and life-size equipments to get a thorough knowledge of nursing.
reviews.review_text: We have atleast 4-5 different labs catering to each department and having human size models, dummies, and equipments. All the procedures and equipments to perform and practice for the future. Our hostel is a very safe and secure place having sets of 2 beds in each room, 6 students in each suite. For food, we have at least 7 different places with amazing food and a way to connect to people. Medical facilities are available 24X7. Sports events and cultural fests happen twice a year.

reviews.review_heading: College infrastructure is good and canteen food is good.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available, classroom is ventilated, and AC is available. Number of options and variety are available. Classrooms and corridors are always clean. Washrooms are clean and hygienic. Air-conditioned classrooms are available. It provides proper uniforms for clinicals. It also provides laboratory facilities and training.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with faculty members. There are 99% placements and really good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of college and hostel is amazing. It has availability of Wi-Fi. Hostel provides clean and quiet environment. Hostel also has medical facilities. We also have labs, library, and classroom. Quality of food is like home and great mess is there.

reviews.review_heading: Studying here always feels like learning something new every day.
reviews.review_text: The environment of the college is very well. They provide good care to the students. Faculty members are very helpful to the students. The canteens are good and only veg and hygiene food is served. Library is also good and all new books are available.

reviews.review_heading: I feel proud as a student of Amity University Haryana.
reviews.review_text: Amity University Haryana has one of the best infrastructure, which is well-maintained in terms of lab classes, library facilities, and the list goes on. AC, non-AC rooms, water cooler, lift, study table, medical facilities, sports complex, playground, and mess food. These are some facilities which are provided to hostellers.

reviews.review_heading: Amity University provided what students needed the most.
reviews.review_text: The facility and the infrastructure are amazing. Classrooms, water facility, library, labs, and Wi-Fi facility are amazing and have all the equipment and books that are needed in the course, and every necessary thing required for the course. Hostel, if we talk about hostel, food is the first thing we have in our mind, and here the food is amazing, including other facilities too, good food quality, and medical facilities, everything is good here.

reviews.review_heading: "Great infrastructure and facilities with diverse student amenities."
reviews.review_text: The ASH department offers excellent infrastructure, including Wi-Fi-enabled campuses and modern classrooms. Hostels are comfortable, but sometimes the food isn't good, while sports facilities enhance the overall student experience, and the medical facilities are also not good in the university.

reviews.review_heading: I would recommend others take admission here, especially if they are looking for hotel management.
reviews.review_text: Students who are interested in sports will find a decent sports complex at this university, and tournaments are held at specific times of the year. Hostels are also decent, with food quality being good and offering variations. Hostels also have recreational rooms.

reviews.review_heading: A balanced college with good opportunities and campus life.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is actually better than many universities. We have a front office lab, restaurant, kitchen, bakery lab, Wi-Fi, and a library everything. There are approximately 5-6 canteens, and they are very clean. The food is also very good and hygienic.

reviews.review_heading: The best private university in Haryana.
reviews.review_text: Clean and tidy classrooms with state-of-the-art infrastructure provide a smooth learning experience. The library is a very comfortable place to study. There are multiple cafeterias on the campus to chose from, offering a variety of meal options. A big sports complex includes sports such as tennis, basketball, badminton, football, volleyball, etc. A medical room is available in the hostel.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. B.Ed. - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied with my university. Students will learn many things at this university.

content.Placements: Placement of students in my course is 100 percent. There is no particular package for my course at university. I don't know about other courses in my university, but there is a placement occurring in PhDs. There are many PhD scholars who are selected for foreign universities. But in my course, there is no placement. Maybe 20-30 percent of students, professor.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure and facilities are the best in my university. Classes, benches, cleanliness, everything is very good, and we feel positive in class.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Chemistry - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Really one of the best central universities.

content.Placements: The placement record is not too good and very limited. Most core-science placements (like in R&D or chemical industries) are not widely available through campus. Some students may get opportunities through faculty referrals or collaborative projects.
content.Infrastructure: Food quality is average, but other hostel facilities are really awesome. Hostel staff and warden are very good and helpful. All rooms are well furnished, and in each room, 2 beds, 2 tables, and 2 chairs are available, and the quality is also good. Overall, the infrastructure is really good.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. LL.B. (Hons.) - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Well, it's affordable and offers a healthy atmosphere for you to grow.

content.Placements: They manage to bag companies and firms to place their students in them. There is an internship and placement cell made for the accommodation of smooth functioning. Insofar as there has been a better placement opportunity in last 2-3 years. University is growing at a high pace.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure and buildings are newly constructed and reliable. It's a growing university, so it tries to provide best for other students and coworkers. Overall, it's a great pico at an affordable price because of its low fee structure as compared to other state universities.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. B.Ed. - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Really a very nice experience in this university.

content.Placements: I'm a student of B.A. B.Ed where our university provides a minimum placement of 30% at an average package of 3-4 LPA in top institutions like D.A.V. In CUSB, 100% of students got internships related to respective government schools. The top role offered in my course is to prepare teachers and professors for educated students.
content.Infrastructure: Well-comfortable classrooms with worth tables, Wi-Fis, huge lab rooms, and a separate library. In our hostel, suitable rooms for students are provided along with proper security CCTV cameras. Proper mess facilities with good food and hygiene, and all medical, sports, and game facilities are available.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. LL.B. (Hons.) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: College is very good, and the infrastructure is excellent. The placement rate is also very high.

content.Placements: The highest salary package offered was 8 LPA and the lowest salary package was 5 LPA. Recruiting companies included Bajaj Finance, Mahindra, Tata, and many others. About 70% of students get placed, and they work in companies as company secretaries and legal advisors.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is very good. A moot court hall is present with high-tech technology and a smart board. Wi-Fi facilities are available, and hostel facility is of three-star quality. Food quality is a bit better, and there is a dispensary for medical treatment.

reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is very good. A moot court hall is present with high-tech technology and a smart board. Wi-Fi facilities are available, and hostel facility is of three-star quality. Food quality is a bit better, and there is a dispensary for medical treatment.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with our college. Good infrastructure and academics.
reviews.review_text: The full campus has Wi-Fi facilities, computer labs, and other departmental labs as needed. Classrooms are neat and clean, although not all have AC. The hostel mess food is very bad, but the canteen food is somehow better.

reviews.review_heading: Central University of South Bihar - my dream college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure related to courses and the hostel is fabulous and outstanding. The university offers only three undergraduate courses: B.A. LL.B. Honors, B.A. B.Ed., and Agriculture Honors. The faculty for each course is excellent and dedicated to the development of students. The hostel infrastructure is amazing, providing every facility from top to bottom.

reviews.review_heading: CUSB present a mixed bag of learning.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilities are good. There is a need to look after mess food. But overall, it is good. The infrastructure for sports is well developed, as there is a stadium, i.e., Milkha Singh Stadium for the supporters. There is a Madhuvan canteen for the student's food.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the faculty and placements.
reviews.review_text: This college has very good infrastructure for our course. Wi-Fi, labs, library, canteen, hostel, etc., facilities are given to the students of this college. The quality of these facilities is good. The mess and canteen food are good to eat. Medical and sports facilities are also available for the students.

reviews.review_heading: Review of CUSB - Central University of South Bihar.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is not bad; it is very friendly and provides a good and spacious environment in both the hostel and course area. We do have a library and a small lab. We have internet access, but it is limited to the course area, and the food in the mess is average but provides both veg and non-veg meals.

reviews.review_heading: Good experience and learning.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good and student-friendly; we can find materials like offline and online resources essential for project work and research papers. There are also labs and good internet connectivity. The classrooms are nicely designed with good space. The hostel has room for laundry; you need to pay a bit extra, but the mess fee is included.

reviews.review_heading: The faculty members and affordability are good options.
reviews.review_text: The hostel living space is good for the amount that they charge, and they provide the best amenities with that. There is a mess where both vegetarian and non-vegetarian food options are available, along with the fact that in the department area we have our classroom, library, lab, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Review of CUSB - Central University of South Bihar.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure in the course area has a dedicated classroom and a library where materials are available. There is an internet connection, but it is limited to the labs area. In the hostel area, we have food available, and for accommodation, you will be given a room, but for other things, you will have to manage.

reviews.review_heading: Review of CUSB - Central University of South Bihar.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure both in the department area as well as the hostel area is quite basic. There is not much new software or available modern amenities. Like new journals or e-resources are very limited; the food is also of average quality, and hostel rooms are available on a sharing basis.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides the best education.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are decent. Our campus is Wi-Fi enabled. Laboratories are excellent. Classrooms are well-maintained. There is a decent library on our campus. Hostel facilities are very good. The food served in the mess is decent. Medical facilities are available. Sports are also conducted in this college.
