reviews.review_heading: MLSU has a serene campus with decent facilities and a strong academic foundation.
reviews.review_text: The campus is spacious, green, and gives a peaceful vibe to the university. The classrooms are clean but not very modern; some buildings show signs of age. The library is genuinely useful, calm, and perfect for study sessions. Wi-Fi works in some places but is inconsistent everywhere. Computer labs work but aren't high-tech. The space given for sports and outdoor activities is there, and basic but affordable food is available at the canteen. Overall, the infrastructure isn't flashy or modern, bu...

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the staff, campus, and education.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is very nice. College campus is vast and diverse in area. Hostel facility is also available and very good. Sports are really taken seriously here. Campus is spread over 6-7 acres of land.

reviews.review_heading: It has affordable courses with good faculty, decent infrastructure, but limited placements.
reviews.review_text: Our college has decent infrastructure, spacious classrooms, a library, and a small psychology lab. Hostel facilities are available separately for both boys and girls. Hygiene and maintenance could be better. Wi-Fi facilities are available on campus, but connectivity is not always consistent.

reviews.review_heading: Decent academics and a peaceful campus, but it lacks practical exposure and strong placements.
reviews.review_text: MLSU's B.Com department has basic facilities like spacious classrooms, a good library, limited Wi-Fi, and access to a computer lab. Hostels are average, mess food is simple and hygienic, and a canteen is available. Medical help is basic, with a campus health center. Sports facilities include playgrounds, indoor games, and a gym.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with faculty, placements, and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure was top-notch. All libraries, classrooms, and labs were excellent. That helped in my studies. The quality of facilities the college provided was also good. The food quality, the sports fields, and the medical facilities were all nice.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the faculty, but you have to dedicate time to your studies.
reviews.review_text: There are Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and a library. Labs are different for MCA and BCA students. Two libraries are here, and there is a mess and medical facilities, but they are not for BCA students. They are for the university, Mohanlal Sukhadia University. So apply if you want to come.

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied with the university, faculty, and placements.
reviews.review_text: The hostel experience is average. There is no Wi-Fi or library. 80% of students live in private PG because the university does not have a place to make students stay. The university infrastructure has been developing but not developed since I was admitted.

reviews.review_heading: Good college, check it ones.
reviews.review_text: My college facilities and infrastructure are above average. It has 1 lab, 1 classroom, and 1 library. There is no Wi-Fi, its not bad infrastructure but same time not good. There is no hostel, no canteen, and no medical facilities. But every month sports and games events are organized by students.

reviews.review_heading: It is an affordable course and shows that the BCA program is budget-friendly.
reviews.review_text: I pursued a BCA in Computer Science from the 024-2026 batch. The infrastructure of the IT department is well-developed. Classrooms are spacious and equipped with smart boards and projectors. High-speed Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus, including labs and library.

reviews.review_heading: Mohanlal Sukhadia University is overall the best college for every student.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides good facilities and an excellent environment for students. The food quality is good, and the library offers the best environment on campus. The medical facilities are average, but we have solid sports and games programs.

reviews.review_heading: College with average fee, good quality, availability of labs, library, canteen, and best study.
reviews.review_text: Mohanlal Sukhadia University in Udaipur had a well-established infrastructure with facilities like spacious classrooms, specialized labs, and a large library. Basic amenities like electricity, water, furniture, and TV rooms were available. Girls' hostel had CCTV surveillance. The hostel mess provided hygienic food. Hostels were located within the university campus. The hostel environment was fresh with a big garden. MLSU had a health center with doctors and nursing staff for the university commu...

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied because of lack of infrastructure and placement cell.
reviews.review_text: There are two libraries, with free A.I.R. subscription. Buildings are nicely ventilated however, classrooms don't get clean that often. Wi-Fi services are not available. The canteen is almost non-existent. No sports infrastructure and medical facilities are also questionable.

reviews.review_heading: I felt disappointed because of the placement issues.
reviews.review_text: Law department classrooms are functional and well-maintained with a healthy and clean environment. Facilities include two libraries with chairs and tables and one library is air-conditioned and has cool drinking water facilities. Washrooms are clean and well-maintained. It provides a canteen and other parking facilities. Hostel facilities are provided with a library, good food, clean mess, washrooms, and other areas. It has sports facilities like basketball, volleyball, badminton, cricket, etc. ...

reviews.batch: Batch of 2024Offered by Shri Govind Guru Government CollegeReviewed on 14 Apr 2025)
reviews.review_heading: It is not outstanding. It has good infrastructure. Faculty members are quite good.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is decent but not outstanding. Classrooms and labs are functional, but average. The library has a massive collection and it is sufficient for basic needs. Sports facilities are available for every sport. The infrastructure is average but sports facilities are good.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2022Offered by Degree Science CollegeReviewed on 2 Apr 2025)
reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure is actually very good.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of my college was very good. The science labs, library, and gym were available in the college and hostel. The quality of food was very good in the hostel. A canteen was also available on the college campus. Medical facilities, games, and sports were provided by the college.

Then, they must enrol themselves in local Bar Council of the concerned state and enrolled as an advocate. Within two years of the enrolment, they must appear and clear AIBE in order to be eligible to practise anywhere in India.

college_info.intro:
Bundelkhand University offers a wide range of courses across streams such as Arts, Science, Computer Applications, Medical, Engineering, Law, Mass Communication, and Management at the UG, PG, and Doctoral levels. The popular programmes at BU Uttar Pradesh are BTech, BSc, and MBA, among others. BU Jhansi offers more than 110 courses.
BU Jhansi offers a full-time, four-year BTech programme at the UG level. The BTech programme offered at the university cover core courses in the areas of Electronics & Communication, Biomedical, CSE, Mechanical, Biotechnology and others. Bundelkhand University MBA programme is a two-year programme. It is offered in several specilisations International Business, Financial Management, Busines Economics, Banking and others. review_summary.college_name: Bundelkhand University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Arts (B.A.) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Great professors and principal.

content.Placements: There are no placements at all. It is a government college so no placements happen. Even in UNIS, as DU I do not think there are placement opportunities for Bachelor degree holders. This much to be expected. You do not join this college to get a job but to get a degree.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is of old times. No new buildings or halls are being built even now. Wi-Fi is sucky at best only works in the library and surrounding areas with the least speed possible. There are no labs as far as I can remember. Classrooms are spacious but thats all.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. (Hons.) in Hindi - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: In all, I want to say my university is one of the best.

content.Placements: In my course, about 60-70% students got placed, and the package lasts between 5-7 LPA according to person to person. In my course literature, there is a provided job. About 70% got an internship with a variety of companies. In my course, you get the role of poet, story writer, and editor.
content.Infrastructure: At university, you will get all types of facilities free of cost, like free Wi-Fi, labs (all types of labs), in the classroom, there is peaceful environment, and teachers give lectures. Hostel in one room, 2-person share and the bed is average, the water system is so good.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Appication (BCA Hons.) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: There has been a lot of improvement in the faculty now.

content.Placements: It is not good for placements, very few companies participate. I completed B.CA (Hons.) in 2022 when the faculty was not so good, but now it has become much better than before. There were no placements during my time at the university. Last time I heard, someone got a package of 6.5 LPA for the B. Teach course.
content.Infrastructure: Talking about infrastructure, it is good. There are more courses, and the hostel is also good. The quality of food was also average at that time, but we can say that it was worth eating and it wasn't that bad.
content.Faculty: Teachers at our time were both helpful and knowledgeable. The course is relevant to the curriculum and makes students industry-ready. I can say the semester exams are average. This college is not that big, so it is very difficult to say about average. To pass, you must have a minimum of 23 marks in each subject after deducting practical marks.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: It is good for living the best college life.

content.Placements: 0.01 % of students get placements from the college campus. No companies visit the college to recruit students from this course only. If we work on our own development, then only we will achieve our dream job. The highest salary offered ranges from Rs. 70,000 to 1.5 lakhs per month. I recommend students do not join this college.
content.Infrastructure: The college is good, but there is no development. The hostel is good for boys and not for girls, due to the outer area. Labs are only for seeing and not for gaining information or for developing skills. Only a few digital classrooms are available here.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: The college is like any other old GMC.

content.Placements: Basically, it is MBBS. After the 4.5-year course, we have to do a mandatory internship. The stipend offered is Rs. 12,000 per month. After that, we have to serve a 2-year bond, which gives a salary that ranges from Rs. 80,000-90,000 per month, but I am not so sure about that. Students prepare for NEET PG if they wish to pursue specialisation in a field.
content.Infrastructure: Since the college is old, the infrastructure is not so good compared to the new colleges. Although labs, etc., are fully functional, the lecture theatre does not have AC or Wi-Fi. Projectors mostly don't work. Hostels are in a paramedical campus where the UG girls stay till the 3rd year, which has new and better infrastructure. But there is a frequent problem with water and electricity.

The university conducts its entrance test, for admission to some UG and PG courses. BU Jhansi has eight faculties that offer UG and PG courses in streams like Science, Law, Commerce, Arts, Medical, Agriculture, Education, Technical & Management. The university has more than 300 colleges affiliated with it. Candidates seeking admission to affiliated colleges have to apply separately on the concerned college's website. Apart from this, the university has 40 institutes of its own. Bundelkhand University admission to any of these institutes is done directly from the university's official website.

paragraphs: Bundelkhand University admission process is a multi-step process. Candidates are first required to register for the course of their choice. The university conducts its own test to shortlist candidates for a few courses. Check below step-wise admission process for BU Jhansi:
STEP 1: Bundelkhand University Application Process 2026
Eligible aspirants need to apply online for the course. Candidates can first register and then fill out the application form. Below is the application fee for Bundelkhand University admission:
INR 1,100 for General Category

STEP 2: Selection

Bundelkhand University selects candidates for UG and PG courses either based on entrance exam or merit in the last qualifying exam. For some of the specialisations, BU Jhansi also conductsBU Entrance Exam.Direct admissionis available based on merit for a few programmes.
STEP 3: Result & Admission Confirmation

Once the BU Entrance Exam results are declared, BU Jhansi releases a merit list announcing the names of the selected candidates. Such applicants have to come for counselling and document verification. Candidates have to pay an additional counselling fee of INR 250. Candidates eligible for direct admission are required to contact on the official e-mail ID of the respective department head to fill the provisional admission process.

faqs.question: How can I get admission in BU Jhansi for B.Ed?
faqs.answer: Bundelkhand University admission to B.Ed is based on UP B.Ed JEE score. faqs.question: Can I apply at Bundelkhand University for B.Ed after Class 12?
faqs.answer: Yes, aspirants who have passed graduation or PG in any discipline with at least 50% aggregate. The university follows NCTE regulations for B.Ed admission. Candidates must have the documents proving their eligibility like Class 12 marksheet, passing certificate, etc. for getting verification at later stages of admission.Besides, meeting the eligibility requirements, aspirants must pass UP B.Ed JEE exam. It is a state-level entrance exam conducted once in a year.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2025Offered by Bundelkhand Degree CollegeReviewed on 8 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: Great professors and principal.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is of old times. No new buildings or halls are being built even now. Wi-Fi is sucky at best only works in the library and surrounding areas with the least speed possible. There are no labs as far as I can remember. Classrooms are spacious but thats all.

reviews.review_heading: In all, I want to say my university is one of the best.
reviews.review_text: At university, you will get all types of facilities free of cost, like free Wi-Fi, labs (all types of labs), in the classroom, there is peaceful environment, and teachers give lectures. Hostel in one room, 2-person share and the bed is average, the water system is so good.

reviews.review_heading: There has been a lot of improvement in the faculty now.
reviews.review_text: Talking about infrastructure, it is good. There are more courses, and the hostel is also good. The quality of food was also average at that time, but we can say that it was worth eating and it wasn't that bad.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by SR Group of Institution JhansiReviewed on 30 Jul 2025)
reviews.review_heading: It is good for living the best college life.
reviews.review_text: The college is good, but there is no development. The hostel is good for boys and not for girls, due to the outer area. Labs are only for seeing and not for gaining information or for developing skills. Only a few digital classrooms are available here.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2029Offered by Maharani Laxmi Bai Medical CollegeReviewed on 30 Jul 2025)
reviews.review_heading: The college is like any other old GMC.
reviews.review_text: Since the college is old, the infrastructure is not so good compared to the new colleges. Although labs, etc., are fully functional, the lecture theatre does not have AC or Wi-Fi. Projectors mostly don't work. Hostels are in a paramedical campus where the UG girls stay till the 3rd year, which has new and better infrastructure. But there is a frequent problem with water and electricity.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by SR Group of Institution JhansiReviewed on 21 Jul 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Placements were good in 2019, and the infrastructure is really good.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of my building is also very well-structured. Hostel facilities are very helpful for our daily work. The taste of hostel food is delicious, cooked with a focus on hygiene, and they always make sure to clean the room.

reviews.review_heading: It's great for studying if you are from a place with less universities and colleges.
reviews.review_text: The faculty members and infrastructure are not too bad. The Wi-Fi is always available, no matter the time. We have labs in our department and smart classrooms, but the interior is not that great either, as it is not painted properly, and desks and tables in a few classrooms are old. The hostel facility is great as per the cost they charge. You can't compare them with top colleges, but they are better than most hostel facilities.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by Choudhary Digvijay Singh MahavidyalayaReviewed on 25 Jun 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Satisfied because of the value for money, good lecturer, and infrastructure is good.
reviews.review_text: The college is very vast. The ground is very big. It contains a physics lab, chemistry lab, biology lab, several classrooms, etc. It has a cricket ground, volleyball ground, badminton court, and football ground. The canteen food is also worth it. The college provides good medical facilities.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2020Offered by SR Group of Institution JhansiReviewed on 20 Jun 2025)
reviews.review_heading: The fee of the college is very nominal about Rs. 30,000 to Rs. 50,000 for those who get fee waivers.
reviews.review_text: The hostel of the college is not very good. The hostel life is not what everyone expects although I'm from Jhansi itself so I didn't join it but got to know about the hostel life. It's like a nightmare for many students, but they do have some Wi-Fi facilities.

reviews.review_heading: All about my university (Bundelkhand University)
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is awesome and well-maintained. A personal auditorium is there in our institute. There are 5 personal labs, in which 1 is a Cyber lab, 1 is a Ballistic lab, 1 is a Chemistry lab, and the other 2 are common practical labs. All labs are active, and the auditorium is also active for extracurricular activities.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2025Offered by Sri Guru Harkishan Degree CollegeReviewed on 26 May 2025)
reviews.review_heading: It is a good college for commerce students.
reviews.review_text: The college has a good campus, with lush green grounds, but there is no canteen facility. There are occasional sports events, basically like kho-kho. There is no Wi-Fi on the campus, it's only available for the teachers.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty is good that's the only reason I don't hate my department.
reviews.review_text: Labs are just fine. Some of the chemicals are expired. Library is okay. No Wi-Fi is provided you need to get your own in hostels. Mess food is just like any other, controversial. I like my department because of my teachers but there is nothing I like about my hostel other than my room.

reviews.review_heading: I'm dissatisfied.
reviews.review_text: The university provides hostels for both girls and boys. There are a total 5 hostels for girls Virangna Khali Ari Bai, Samta, Annex, and OBC. Infrastructure is good. The quality of food is not that much of good. Wi-Fi isn't working. Classrooms are okay. Medical facilities are also not that good in hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Campus is okay but the department is average with no placement.
reviews.review_text: Hostel is okay if only you can adjust to their long list of rules and regulations. The girl's hostel mess is so average. In the summer, the problem we face is electricity. The hostel gate closes at 6:50 PM only and if you want to take leave, you'll have to follow a very long and unnecessary procedure.

reviews.review_heading: Nice and decent for any course.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of the college and my course is good. There are different labs for the practices and computer labs. There is a personal auditorium and the classrooms are very nice and clean. Faculty of the hostel is very polite and gives support to whatever you need.

overview_faqs.question: Is Chandigarh Group of Colleges, Landran a good college?
overview_faqs.answer: Yes, Chandigarh Group of Colleges (CGC), Landran is a good college as it is one of the premier colleges in Chandigarh. The college received rank 3 in Punjab among the Top 50 private institutes by the Times B School Rankings 2024. It offers 55+ courses under seven domains, namely Engineering, Biotechnology, Computer Application, Management, Education, Pharmacy and Hotel Management. The college has 8 different colleges under CGC and all these colleges are affiliated with IK Gujral Punjab Technical University (IKGPTU), NCHMCT, and Punjabi University (Patiala).

overview_faqs.question: Is BCA worth from CGC Landran?
overview_faqs.answer: BCA is one of the top course of CGC Landran. The institute attracted more than 800 recruiters for its 2023 placement session who offered a variety of job roles to the students across sectors, such as BFSI, IT, Education, FMCG, Consulting, and E-Commerce, etc. The top recruiters of CGC Landran in 2023 included Deloitte, Amazon, Infosys, IBM, Cognizant, Microsoft, Wipro, TCS, Accenture, etc. These recruiters placed students in various sectors and offered new-age job profiles. In the recent placement drive, BCA students were offered a the highest package of INR 19.25 LPA. As per the latest report, over 800 recruiters participated in the placement process 2023 and presented over 8,500 job offers to the students of various courses. Click here to know more about CGC Landran Placements.

review_summary.college_name: CGC Landran Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Good infrastructure, Good teachers.

content.Placements: Don't know currently as I am in 2nd semester. Placements are solid? About 80% get placed. The highest package hit 15LPA, average is 6LPA. Big names like Amazon and Wipro visit. Around 70% land internships by 3rd year, mostly in teach and marketing roles. It? S a pretty reliable track record.
content.Infrastructure: The labs and Wi-Fi are actually great, and the library has every book I? Ve needed. Hostel life is okay rooms are decent, but mess food is definitely hit-or-miss. Canteen snacks and the sports complex are the real highlights here. Solid experience, enjoying.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering (Cyber Security) - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Overall, a good college for your career development.

content.Placements: A very good college in placement criteria, 70 percent of students are placed every year, with an average package of 5 LPA-6 LPA. The highest is 44 LPA, and many companies visit every year and provide internships, also for experienced students, who can transform their life very easily in college.
content.Infrastructure: A good infrastructure with good services and environment, hostel food is a bit bad, but overall facilities are good, safe for girls, strict guards at the gate don't allow outsiders in college. The canteens are available for day scholars and students. Overall have a good infrastructure. Labs are available for better understanding, and students can experience real-time experiences in this college.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Biotechnology - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Good college to experience.

content.Placements: Students in my course are placed according to their interests if they want to pursue their studies further. They can, and if they want placement, they can take the TPP subject for Rs. 4,000 or Rs. 5,000 for being placed. The average package is, I think, 4 LPA to 5 LPA. The best thing about our department is that we can also sit in pharmacy placements and in marketing placements, which gives us a chance. They provide internships that are paid, in college only, and unpaid, also that are linked to organisations like PBTI, thank you.
content.Infrastructure: Department's infrastructure and facilities are good, there is Wi-Fi, labs are there, classrooms for different sections are there, library is there, on other hand, the food in hostel is average, infrastructure is good, canteen is good, medical facilities are good, sports and games are genuinely good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Average and budget-friendly option with normal placements.

content.Placements: 50-60% of students were placed, and the lowest package was 3.5 LPA, whereas the highest package went to 18-20 LPA. Companies like EPAM, PhysicsWallah, Watchguard, TCS, Cognizant, FICO, Deloitte, Accenture, KPIT, LG, Namma Yatri and DBS were the recruiting companies. Top roles offered were Quality Analyst, Software Developer, and Data Analyst, and there were not many internships that were offered.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is just average, classrooms are pretty much normal, and there is no Wi-fi. The library is also not that big and has just basic course-related books. Labs are also not that highly developed. The boys' hostel is good, but in the girls' hostel, many problems do occur, and the mess food is not that good, but they do have variety, and food is provided on time. Basic medical facilities are available on campus, and there is an arrangement of sports too. Also, a plus point is that the hostel does have a gym, and the campus is quite beautiful and peaceful in the evening.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Review of Chandigarh Group of Colleges, Landran

content.Placements: Placement is good. About 65 percent of last semester's students got placed. The average package is about 5–6 LPA. Placement drives are continuing. Students from Chandigarh Engineering College also go to Chandigarh University during placement drives, as they have joint placements.
content.Infrastructure: The entire campus is Wi-Fi connected, and the classrooms are big enough. They have proper fans, lighting, and exhaust fans. Every classroom has a projector and a whiteboard. Hostel food is average, sometimes good, and sometimes bad. Non-veg food is available on selected days in the hostel mess. Medical services are available 24/7 with an ambulance for emergencies. Grounds for football, volleyball, basketball, and badminton are available.

reviews.review_heading: Good college to experience.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides good facilities that help us in making our careers and improving our skills.

Our college also introduces various sports events like volleyball, cricket, badminton, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, a good college for your career development.

The canteens are available for day scholars and students. Overall have a good infrastructure. Labs are available for better understanding, and students can experience real-time experiences in this college.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is very good for placement.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of our course is the best. Infrastructure is very good. Wi-Fi is available in all classes. All labs are good. Classrooms are very good in library, and all books are available. Quality of hostel facilities is good. The quality of food in mess and canteen is very good.

reviews.review_heading: My college name is Chandigarh Group of College.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are best free Wi-Fi, library access, and well-developed labs. Food quality is good and also mess and canteen facilities are good. It is very clean and mostly everything is available. Medical facilities are proper. There is proper facility for sports and games.

reviews.review_heading: The fee is minimal, but according to their placements, there are some bad things.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is quite good, but the hostel food is very bad. Labs are okay. The library is good. There is no Wi-Fi for students' self-study.

reviews.review_heading: We are not happy with the placements.
reviews.review_text: All things are available but Wi-Fi facilities are not available for the students that are not good. They also have to provide Wi-Fi facilities for students so that they can use them to improve their online teaching skills which is very useful for the future.

reviews.review_heading: It has good infrastructure and facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Supportive faculty, decent placements, and great campus facilities.

When the admission session is going on they make good food and make parents happy but we only know the reality. There are two types of hostels. There are AC and non-AC rooms with different prices.

reviews.review_heading: Excellent infrastructure, good placement, and lots of memories.

faqs.question: How can I get direct admission in MIT-WPU?
faqs.answer: MIT-WPU Pune does not offer direct admission to its UG and PG courses. MIT-WPU course admissions for all courses are either done via MIT-WPU CET, which is conducted by the university itself. The university also accepts various state and national-level entrance exams such as PERA CET, JEE Main, CAT, MAT, NEET UG, etc. Those who want to get admission to any of the UG and PG courses at MIT-WPU, must fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria in the first place and then appear for the respective entrance exams. For some PG courses such as MBA and MCA, the university also accepts valid scores in personal interview rounds as part of their selection process. The final seat allotment is done based on the counselling rounds.

faqs.question: How can I get admission to BBA at MIT-WPU?
faqs.answer: For MIT-WPU BBA admissions, candidates need to fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria, i.e., to pass Class 12 with 60% aggregate with English subject in any stream (at least 55% marks, in case of Backward class category candidate belonging to Maharashtra State only). Else, those who have Diploma with 60% aggregate in any stream from Any UGC-approved Institution or equivalent with English as a subject can also apply. Admission to BBA at MIT-WPU is entrance-based. Candidates need to qualify for MIT-WPU CET exam which is conducted by the university itself. The final selection is based on the performance of candidates in the Personal Interview rounds.

placement_data.title: MIT-WPU, Pune Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: MIT-WPU, Pune has released the placement details for the Class of 2025. More than 730 recruiters visited the campus for 2025 placements and selected 2455 students of the batch 2025. The overall highest package offered to the batch 2025 stood at INR 51.36 LPA , whereas the average salary offered was INR 6.23 LPA. The median salary offered to the batch 2025 was INR 5.50 LPA . The top recruiters of MIT-WPU, Pune in 2025 include Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Intel, Goldman Sachs, etc. Apart from securing the annual package, the students also received internship opportunities from the recuiters in 2025. The highest stipend offered was INR 80,000.

Earlier, the highest package offered during MIT-WPU, Pune placement 2024 stood at INR 51.36 LPA. A total 2,544 students registered, of which 1,903 were placed in leading companies. More than 600 companies visited the campus.
The students of the BDes batch 2023 secured the highest package of INR 20 LPA.

hostel_campus.college_name: MIT-WPU

hostel.description:
MIT-WPU provides students with modern and comfortable hostel facilities, catering to diverse needs and interests. Equipped with amenities such as dance studios, gyms, basketball courts, and inviting common areas, the hostels offer a vibrant and engaging living environment. Students have the flexibility to choose between twin-sharing and triple-sharing rooms, each furnished with unlimited high-speed Wi-Fi and regular housekeeping services. 

The safety of students is a top priority, with full-time wardens, CCTV monitoring, and biometric-enabled entrances ensuring a secure living space. MIT-WPU's commitment to providing well-equipped and secure hostels reflects its dedication to creating a conducive and enriching residential experience for its students.

reviews.review_heading: Great College, possibly have a lot of money, but it has a very strict attendant policy.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the syllabus and the course is very interesting, and we get to go to the rural areas for some days and a national study trip. I can’t tell you much about the hostel as I am not in MIT hostel, but as per what I have listened, the rooms are really good. Hostel food and its quality is not very promising. They have lots and lots of sports activities.

reviews.review_heading: It's a good college for anyone genuinely interested.
reviews.review_text: The campus is neat and clean. There are clear rules mentioned, and actions are also taken against violators. I can't say anything about the food as I haven't tried it, but the vibe of the campus is top class, especially when it rains. The crowd is amazing too, and we will feel like coming to college every day.

reviews.review_heading: Good college with balanced academics and campus life.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is modern. Our department has well-equipped labs with Macs and high-speed Wi-Fi. Hostel facilities are decent, the mess food is manageable, not amazing, but edible. One girls' hostel is on the campus itself, but the only boys' hostel is around 8-9km away from the campus; however, the college provides bus facilities. Sports grounds, indoor games, and medical facilities are available in the new sports complex.

reviews.review_heading: Strong cybersecurity programme with supportive faculty.
reviews.review_text: The entire academic building and labs are covered with campus-wide Wi-Fi. In speak hours, it may slow a bit, but overall connectivity is reliable. Most CSE classes are conducted in newer academic blocks, so classrooms feel modern. The biggest library you'll find in Pune has various books from different streams available. Hostel rooms are not luxurious, but comfortable and functional. Mess Food is average to good, completely veg. MIT has 2 different canteens, one of the premium ones called Encave...

reviews.review_heading: It is one of the best college.
reviews.review_text: It has excellent infrastructure and it has availability of Wi-Fi labs classrooms and library. Library is to good for this college. I did not see any college that has this kind of library.  Hostel canteen food is not that good. Sports and game facilities are good. It has a dark side also some students are addicted to drugs and do wrong things. 1 or 2 months ago there a child ordered something from Blinkit and some things happened that the Blinkit boy beat our campus student he was full of blood.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the college and faculty.
reviews.review_text: The college has great on-campus hostels with Wi-Fi and all amenities. The library is just mesmerising, its ambience is on another level. Classrooms have a great ambience, as in our department. Mess food is average, but the sports facilities are just amazing. Overall, it's excellent.

reviews.review_heading: My review of this college.
reviews.review_text: The course curriculum was different from the rest of the colleges. There was a brew of finance, operations, marketing, and HR for the elective options. They imparted both theoretical and practical knowledge. It was a very flexible system that favors students for their betterment. The hostel was completely air conditioned and was equipped with free Wi-Fi. There was ample space provided for the balcony and terrace. The rooms were dual sharing with separate washroom facilities for each room. The me...

reviews.review_heading: The college has good and friendly faculty with a fresh environment and campus.
reviews.review_text: Our campus has good facilities of Wi-Fi, smart Google classrooms, and well-stocked libraries. Hostel facilities are designed with hygienic food. Even with the good medical facilities and well-trained doctors. The college also supports sports and various national and international competitions.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely dissatisfied with the faculty.
reviews.review_text: We have a specially designed Vyasa building for CSE branch students. It's definitely amazing, the labs are brand new, and each system actually works. The only thing is that the network connectivity is terrible. The mess is good, but the En Encave Cafe is below average.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements with top-notch infrastructure, but the fees are a little bit on the higher side.
reviews.review_text: Cannot comment on hostel as I am a day scholar. Infrastructure available is of top-notch quality. Many canteens are available on the campus. Library has some limited books and is not up to date.

reviews.review_heading: MIT WPU  This is the reality.
reviews.review_text: There are well-developed and invested labs for different subjects. Campus has Wi-Fi. Library is also very useful and very accessible. Campus has a medical room for emergencies, and the hostels are decent. Hostels are okay, but they are extremely far away from the college. Although the college offers transport, it gets tiring to travel that much every single day.

reviews.review_heading: Review of MIT-WPU.
reviews.review_text: For CSE, we have a new building, and it has top-notch infrastructure. 4 labs on each floor, and each lab has 70 iMac setups. Canteens are really good, and the on-campus café too. We also have a sports complex where the ground floor has a huge swimming pool, which is very clean, and above that is the indoor games floor, like table tennis, and on top, we have a badminton hall.

reviews.review_heading: MIT WPU CSE  Industry oriented curriculum with lively campus culture.
reviews.review_text: College offers smart classrooms, MAC labs, library, and research space. Hostels are not that good but have clean rooms, study areas, and Wi-Fi. Mess food is the worst. Sports and recreation are average, with a decent basketball court, table tennis, and a gym. Overall, the infrastructure supports both academics and student life effectively.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2025Offered by School of Business, MIT WPUReviewed on 10 Aug 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Most of the students are getting job offers.
reviews.review_text: Our college infrastructure is top-notch. The whole campus is Wi-Fi enabled, labs are properly equipped, and a central library is located with a variety of books. The hostel is great. Hostel rooms are properly cleaned, and all types of facilities are available here.

reviews.review_heading: An excellent college for an MBA with a majority of pros.
reviews.review_text: My college provides excellent facilities and infrastructure. The campus is spread over huge acres and surrounded by greenery everywhere, fostering vibrant campus life. Classes are present with smart interactive board and Wi-Fi access, a huge library with spacious seating for students, and a lot of books. There are 3 canteens in college which offer great food.

hostel_campus.college_name: KIET Ghaziabad Infrastructure Details & Reviews

reviews.review_heading: The campus is a bit small, but infrastructure-wise good, too good a football ground.
reviews.review_text: All labs are equipped with Wi-Fi and cameras, as well as classrooms and a library. There's a well-equipped library as well, with full AC, and all classrooms have 3 AC's. I live in a hostel, so I can answer better. The quality of food is good, sometimes food is so bad, sometimes too good. Some hostel also has sports facilities, so overall okay.

reviews.review_heading: KIET college review by rookie.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is actually good. Labs are modern. Wi-Fi is good when on less traffic. Decently maintained infrastructure. Sports facilities are not good as it is a small campus. Library is decent. Hostel mess food is pretty good. Campus is fully air-conditioned.

reviews.review_heading: Very good college, satisfied with teachers and placements.
reviews.review_text: The hostel and canteens have great food. Each classroom is very spacious. They have AC fans and smart boards in every class. The hall is quite big as well. The structure is really good. It is around 20 acres, but they have planned it very well.

reviews.review_heading: Decent placement with effort, strong campus life, mixed academic experience.
reviews.review_text: Currently, it is in the development phase, but overall, it is nice and clean. Everything that is required for the students and faculty is available in the respective facility areas. Wi-Fi, labs, and classes are all clean and comfortable. The management and maintenance of these facilities are very impressive.

reviews.review_heading: Enough and worth it in comparison to other private colleges.
reviews.review_text: All of the facilities available, like hostels, free campus Wi-Fi 24/7, advanced labs like computer organisation, logical design, micro electronics lab, analogue communication lab, 10 on 10 quality of facilities, library and a book resource centre are also available.

reviews.review_heading: Good placement and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The college provides very good infrastructure for the mechanical engineering students. The labs are well-equipped with modern machines and instruments, classrooms are spacious with projectors and proper ventilation, and the library has a good collection of textbooks, reference books, and digital resources.

reviews.review_heading: A good college at this fee, which provides both knowledge and a "DECENT JOB."
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very good, like every place, it is very well furnished and air-conditioned. There is Wi-Fi available in every part of the campus, and there are separate buildings for different departments. There are two reading halls. One is available till 5 PM and the other one till 2 AM. Labs are good and well-equipped. There are around 5-6 hostels, including both boys' and girls'. The food quality, for me, is mediocre; it's like some days it's good, and some days it can be bad. The cant...

reviews.review_heading: A genuine review of the KIET group of Institutions from a second-year CS student.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good, but not the best. Although a new Mac lab has been built this year, other labs are still not good and feel outdated. The infrastructure of the college is quite good, but it needs some improvement, especially in the mechanical labs. Some labs are good, like the 3D printing lab and the CNC lab. There are two libraries in the college, one of which is very big and has a vast collection of books and resources. Most canteens are okay but need some improvement in seating and ...

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with campus, good placement in 2022.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure and the hostel are just amazing. The best campus in Delhi NCR. A lot of facilities are provided, like Wi-Fi, labs, a library, and AC in classrooms. There are 5 canteens in the college, a few of them being Healthy Hut, Green Chilli, Nescafé, and Big Treat.

reviews.review_heading: My most honest feedback. Average placement and faculty.
reviews.review_text: This college is known for its amazing infrastructure. We have Wi-Fi accessibility everywhere, and charging ports are available on each desk in each class. The library is good, where you can get the books issued, and the management keeps introducing new books. The hostel has everything good except the mess. So, not talking about the food, medical facilities are always available, and you can play sports and games. College has a volleyball, basketball and badminton court. Girls are not allowed to l...

reviews.review_heading: A genuine review of KIET Group of Institutions, Ghaziabad, from a 2nd-year student.
reviews.review_text: Although a new MAC lab has been built this year, other labs are still not good and feel outdated. The infrastructure of the college is quite good but needs some improvements. Labs are mostly outdated, especially the mechanical labs, but some new labs are good, like the CNC lab and 3D printing lab. There are two libraries in the college, one of which has a vast collection of books and resources. Most canteens are good but need some improvement in seating and crowd management.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty is really bad good infrastructure average placements wonderful fests and tech events.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available everywhere inside the college. Labs are also equipped with good facilities. We have a library and a reading room. Although there are not many good books to read in the library technology related. The experience is quite good. The water index is really bad. Many of my friends complain about losing hair and having pimples. Mess food is average and canteen food is good but you cannot eat it every day. A doctor is always available. We have a cricket club volleyball club athletics ...

reviews.review_heading: Good college with helpful teachers, nice campus, and decent placements.
reviews.review_text: The college has good infrastructure. Classrooms are clean and have projectors. Computer labs are updated with the latest software. There is high-speed Wi-Fi available across the campus. The library has many useful books. Hostels are neat, safe, and comfortable. Mess food is okay. It could be better. There are also sports grounds, a canteen, and a gym. Overall infrastructure is good and well-maintained.

reviews.review_heading: My review of KIET as a first year.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure-wise, this college is good, but the biggest con is that it has quite a small campus of 17 acres. However, the main buildings are well maintained. They provide all types of facilities, labs are well-equipped, Wi-Fi is available throughout the whole campus, and sports facilities are also there along with a gym and all.

reviews.review_heading: Placement is average, but campus life is good.
reviews.review_text: College has good infrastructure with high-speed Wi-Fi and is green and clean. The hostel is clean and the rooms are comfortable. Mess food is also good. Classrooms are fully air-conditioned, and every seat has 2 charging ports to charge a mobile laptop. We can say that the facilities are good.

After clearing the entrance examination, candidates should appear for the counselling process, and the final admission will be done based on the marks obtained in the entrance examination and counselling process. Candidates must have applied for the course through the Anurag University official website and meet the eligibility criteria for the course.

faqs.question: How can I get B.Pharma Mathematics at Anurag University?
faqs.answer: At Anurag University, B.Pharma  primarily does not include mathematics as a major subject B.Pharma at Anurag University is primarily a pharmaceutical Science program. And here B.Pharma focuses majorly on pharmacy, drug design, manufacturing, and related sciences. However if you are so much interested in pursuing mathematics then u can do it along side such as you can pursue a Bachelor's degree in Mathematics alongside a Pharmacy-related programme or you can also consider maths as a minor subject while studying B.Pharma.

faqs.question: How should I prepare myself to get into Anurag University for B.Tech Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning?
faqs.answer: To get admission to Anurag University for B.Tech AIML you must have to pass the +2 level with a minimum of 45% and make sure you prioritize your academics, especially in subjects that will be crucial for the program - Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry.Anurag University accepts scores from various entrance exams for this program. Look into exams like TS EAMCET. So you must have to give an entrance exam and score good marks.You have to be familiar with programming languages like Python and R.

placement_data.title: Kumaun University Placement Overview 2024
paragraphs: According to Kumaun University overall NIRF report 2024, the median package offered during Kumaun University UG 3-year and PG 2-year placements 2023 stood at INR 1.2 LPA and INR 2 LPA , respectively. Further, as per the Management and Pharmacy NIRF reports 2024, the median package offered during Kumaun University MBA, BPharm and MPharm placements 2023 stood at INR 5 LPA , INR 2.5 LPA and INR 4 LPA, respectively.

faqs.question: How much does MBA at Kumaun University cost?
faqs.answer: Fee structure MBA at Kumaun University vary with speciallity. The fees for PGDM course is 2.04K - 1.20L INR. And it is a 3 year programme. With 100 percent placement rate and a great ROI. So MBA at Kumaun University will cost you around 10K-3.8L INR.

faqs.question: How much does BCA at Kumaun University cost?
faqs.answer: Total fees for BCA (3years) is 33,486INR with additional one time charges of 1000INR . And a security deposit of 5000INR which is refundable after the course completion. The hostel charges are extra which are to be paid after the admission at the time of room allocation.

faqs.question: Do students get their ROI after completing MBA from Kumaun University?
faqs.answer: The total fees for 2 year MBA from Kumaun University is 2.04K - 1.39L INR which vary with the speciality of course. And they get placed in top mnc's companies and organisations with a median salary of 2.5L INR oncampus (*as per records of last two years). So, The ROI after completing MBA from Kumaun University is great as compared to the fees of the programme.

faqs.question: What are the career opportunities available after completing BBA course from Kumaun University?
faqs.answer: Kumaun University and its affiliated colleges offer BBA courses in different specialisations. Thus, candidates are able to get a job position based on the specialsiation they have chosen. Moreover, as per the subjects studied in the BBA course, candidates can work in the fields of Finance, Business Administration, and relevant fields. Have a look at some of the career opportunities after obtaining a BBA from Kumaun University: Marketing Manager Financial Analyst Human Resources Manager Digital Marketing Specialist Business Analyst Entrepreneur Cybersecurity Consultant Hospital & Healthcare Manager Retail Manager Logistics Manager

review_summary.college_name: Uttaranchal University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: It is excellent as it helps us achieve our dreams.

content.Placements: Students are placed in various companies such as Wipro, Deloitte, HCL, Tech Mahindra, TCS, and many more. The highest package is 1.24 crores, the lowest package is 2.4 LPA, and the average package is 4 LPA. About 55% of students get internships at companies like Codetech and Wipro. The top roles offered in my course are web developer, app developer, and cybersecurity.
content.Infrastructure: All facilities are available in classrooms and laboratories, including lab assistants, good Wi-Fi, and a neat and clean environment. The campus is very clean. In the hostel, all basic facilities are provided, such as a table, an almirah, a shoe rack, a chair, a fan, a water cooler, and a geyser. The food quality in the mess is good, but sometimes it is not that good. Medical facilities are available 24/7 as there is a hospital on the campus. Sports are held 2–3 times a year.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Really good infrastructure, but the fees are a little bit on the higher side, education is good.

content.Placements: If you work beyond average, you can get a package. The average 4 to 5 LPA you can expect. Many companies visit the college. Mainly, job offers are on the marketing side. The highest package they claim in BBA is 10 LPA, and the average is 4 to 5 LPA. 70 to 80 per cent of students get internships.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is on top-notch, no compromises with this. All facilities are available, like Wi-Fi campus, green campus, each library for each department, canteen food is at a reasonable price, sports available, games available in the hostel, and Wi-Fi speed is a little slow.

content.Infrastructure: The university offers good facilities for the B.Sc. IT department, including high-speed Wi-Fi, well-equipped computer labs, smart classrooms, and a resourceful central library. Hostels are clean, secure, and provide Wi-Fi, 24/7 electricity, and common rooms. The mess and canteen food are hygienic and decent, with multiple options. Medical needs are handled through an on-campus health centre with first-aid and ambulance availability. The campus also has indoor and outdoor sports facilities, including grounds, courts, and recreation areas. Overall, the infrastructure is well-maintained and student-friendly.

admission_overview.title: Uttaranchal University Admission Overview 2025
admission_overview.description: Uttaranchal University admission 2025 is both entrance and merit-based. The university offers a wide range of courses at undergraduate, postgraduate, and diploma levels. Uttaranchal University accepts relevant entrance exam scores to shortlist candidates for admission. For instance, admission to the BTech course is done based on the rank secured in JEE Main and for MBA, Uttaranchal University accepts MAT/ CAT /CMAT / XAT/ UU Entrance Test scores. Further, merit in the last qualifying exam is also considered for admission to courses, such as BA. Uttaranchal University courses are offered through its various constituent schools and institutes. The courses are offered in various areas of study such as Management, Engineering, Law, etc. Interested students can read the following article to learn all about the eligibility criteria, courses, and admission procedure of the university.

The University shortlists candidates either based on merit secured in the qualifying exam or based on the performance of candidates in the entrance exam. All the applicants must appear for the personal interview round. Interested students can check out theUttaranchal University admission processfrom below:

Theapplication processis conducted in bothonline & offline modes. To apply online candidates are required to visit the official website of the university & click on the apply now option to fill out the application form. Candidates can also visit theUttaranchal University campus& purchase the application form from the admission office.
Step 2:Selection Process

To shortlist candidates, Uttaranchal University accepts various national-level entrance examination scores like JEE Main, MAT, XAT, NEET etc. as per the stream of the programme. The university also shortlists candidatesbased on merit secured in the qualifying examinations.Students are also called in for personal interview as per the criteria of the desired programme.
Step 3: Final Admission

Shortlisted candidates will get an offer letter from the university. They need to pay the admission confirmation fee to accept the offer, post which, the students will receive the admission confirmation letter.

hostel_campus.college_name: Uttaranchal University Infrastructure Details & Reviews

hostel.description: The hostel of Uttaranchal University has a provision for the single room, double room, three bed and four-bedroom. Each room is furnished with bed/beds, mattress, study table, chair, cupboard and curtains. 4000 boys and girls can accommodate in the campus hostel. There are spacious lawns within the hostel campus for the students to play different games or to take walk or recreate themselves. Great care is taken to maintain hygienic conditions and cleanliness. Hostel common rooms are fully equipped with HD TV network, indoor games, newspapers and laundry staff. There is a separate group of hostel maintenance staff under the active supervision of the Chief Warden. The hostel offers many exciting experiences both in the terms of games and entertainment.

library.description: The Uttaranchal University’s library holds a hybrid collection of 125000 books, 125 current periodicals, 1000 back volumes, 15 National newspapers, 1000+ e-journals and e-books of National / International societies  500+ dissertations and over 2500 CDs/DVDs.  The bibliographical details and content pages for all the books are accessible through OPAC. The Library has a collection of approximately 3500 clippings concerning to topics relevant to the academic community of the University. The Library has a multimedia section to access NPTEL video lectures on various subjects and topics.

faqs.answer: Assam University accepts admission through various national-level, state-level & university-level entrance exams. faqs.question: What to do after JEE Main session 2 result?

Those who are above the 98th percentile should start preparing for JEE Advanced as soon as possible. Those below this, between the 95th and 98th percentile, should focus on attempting more mock tests and previous year question papers so that they have a better chance of clearing JEE Advanced

reviews.review_heading: This is one of the best universities for the M.Sc. in Earth Sciences course.
reviews.review_text: There are a few small libraries and research centers on campus. The university lacks infrastructure compared to older universities, but it is good enough. The football team is recognized at other universities as well. The university has wonderful hostels, with vacant rooms. Water regulations ensure that buildings are adequately cooled even in summer.

reviews.review_heading: Review of my college and my college life, and how we enjoyed ourselves in college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is great, but we don't have Wi-Fi connections. The classrooms, labs, and library are also very good. We have both boys' common rooms and girls' common rooms too, where we can play indoor games like carrom, chess, ludo, etc. In our college, we don't have hostel facilities.

reviews.review_heading: A good decision to take this college.
reviews.review_text: Everything is there, including Wi-Fi connections, books, science labs, and different classrooms for different subjects. Hostel food is good. The mess provides good food, and the security system is too good. There are medical centers that absolutely give free treatment and medicine. We have our own field for sports and games.

reviews.review_heading: GC University Silchar provides quality education, supportive faculty, and active campus life.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of GC University Silchar is quite good. The classrooms are spacious and equipped with smart boards, projectors, and Wi-Fi access. The library is well-stocked with textbooks, reference materials, and e-resources, along with a digital library facility. Our department has modern labs (computer/science) with updated equipment to support practical learning. The hostel facilities are decent, with clean rooms, adequate water supply, and Wi-Fi connectivity. The mess provides hygienic ...

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by Gurucharan CollegeReviewed on 31 Jul 2025)
reviews.review_heading: The golden days of my life.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is very good, and the college is engaged in advancing its infrastructure day by day. All the necessary equipment is available in the college, and the college is very reputable for its well-decorated facilities. It has all the required equipment, such as laboratories, libraries (which is a central library), a highly advanced digital board in each classroom, well-maintained toilets, and boys' and girls' common rooms.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, it's good but not excellent.
reviews.review_text: Hostel is not that good. Three students are to be fitted into a room where it's difficult to live, as for Wi-Fi there is no Wi-Fi. But there is Wi-Fi in the library and campus. There are games and sports facilities but limited. Food quality in hostel is not good either.

reviews.review_heading: Not great for placements.
reviews.review_text: There are hostels but unfortunately new students probably won't get any room since lack of rooms. They get priority based on distance from the university to their home. One room can accommodate 3 students. There is no modern canteen. As for medical, there's only one, according to my knowledge.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm.) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Good faculty members with friendly nature and greenery surroundings.

content.Placements: I am pursuing my 3rd year of B.Pharma, and our batch is really good in skills and quality knowledge. About 100% of students are placed in companies if they don't want to PG. Top companies also approach our college. This course is very well-perfectioned for the future.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is greenery surrounding covered with fresh air, the best Wi-Fi, and other lab facilities. There's also well-maintained hygiene in every area, and classes are fitted with projectors. The hostel is not up to the mark but is average. The library is also good for study.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm.) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Some faculty members are very friendly. 2023 was the best year. Good infrastructure and auditorium.

content.Placements: Coming to placements every year there are placements for output batches. The highest package is around 2.4 LPA-2.8 LPA and the lowest is 2.2 LPA. All top most companies visit for placement interviews. There are separate programs in college which is placement cell. Every year college provide internship courses for students' skill development in industries. Overall, it's a good pharmacy college for developing new ideas.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure of college is so good with green surroundings. Classrooms are well-designed with projectors and labs are also well-designed with the availability of drugs needed for experiments. There's a library with all books needed for pharmacy course and also central library associated near college. It also provide good Wi-Fi network offering high-speed. Labs have good facilities with trained professors.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Review of BGS Institute of Technology.

content.Placements: Placement statistics of our college show that the average salary package provided to the selected candidates on campus drive arranged by the college was 5.1 LPA. Our college also invites other college students to participate in the drive arranged by them. About 60% of students have a chance to get internships.
content.Infrastructure: A high level of security is available all over the campus. There is no chance for the happening of rule-breaking and other in-disciplinary activities. It collects affordable fees for placements, tuition fees, and transportation. It also has a spacious parking area to park a lot of two-wheelers and four-wheelers.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: I'm satisfied with faculty members and facilities of our college.

content.Placements: " In the MBA course, a decent number of students got successfully placed from our college. The average salary package varies from 4 LPA-7 LPA. Top recruiters in our college are from the management and consulting fields. Top roles offered are CRM, consultant, HR, recruiters, etc.
content.Infrastructure: BGS Institute has a good infrastructure for MBA. Facilities in the college are good enough, including Wi-Fi, labs, library, canteen, hostel, sports, etc. Facilities are available for students. Hostel facilities are also good. The quality of food in hostel mess is good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Good infrastructure but bad placements.

content.Placements: Placements are not good as of now. Only two companies came to date and hired only girls. Accenture was our top recruiter, and that was also scheduled due to some technical issues. They are also hiring mostly girls in other colleges. The highest package was around 6 LPA, and the lowest was around 3 LPA. Some students got internships by their own skill in both big companies and start-ups. The top roles offered were junior developer, associate developer, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is good. Labs are facilitated with the latest PCs, have free college Wi-Fi, classrooms are good, and have projectors. The library is good with a variety of books and free Wi-Fi. The hostel facility is good, but the quality of food is bad sometimes. But the college canteen serves good food at an affordable price. Has good medical facilities as the medical college is next to us. Has all kinds of sports equipment and courts. And sports tournaments and championships will be conducted by both the university and students.

For entrance based admission, the university accepts national level entrance exam scores such as NEET UG, NEET PG, ACUET etc. Adichunchanagiri University conducts its own entrance test, ACUET followed by a personal interview, for PhD programmes. Adichunchanagiri university offers over 30 courses spread across different domains that include Medical and Allied Health Sciences, Pharmacy, Nursing, Engineering, Management and Technology , Humanities and Social Sciences, Natural Sciences. The university offers both online and offline application options for UG and PG. The admission process involves eligibility verification and application fee payment.

faqs.question: What are the course details for BSc Nursing at Adichunchanagiri University?
faqs.answer: BSc Nursing at Adichunchanagiri University is a full time, four year course spread over eight semesters. the total tuition fees for the course amounts to INR 5.20 lakh. There are a total of 60 seats available at the university for the course. The common eligibility for this course is qualification of Second PUC/Class 12 / equivalent exam conducted by the State /Central Government authorities with English as one of the subjects and Physics, Chemistry, and Biology as optional subjects. Student must have secured 40% marks in aggregate in Physics, Chemistry, Biology and English. The selection criteria for the same is merit based.

faqs.question: What are the eligibility requirements for PG courses at Adichunchanagiri University?
faqs.answer: At Adichunchanagiri University, the common eligibility for PG courses is passing UG in the respective subject with 40-50% of aggregate marks. For MD and MS, the common eligibility is passing NEET PG. In addition, the university also conducts its own entrance exam, ACUET.  The selection criteria of the university is both merit based and entrance based. The university accepts scores of national level/state level entrance exams along with ACUET.

faqs.question: What are the specialisations available under PhD at Adichunchanagiri University?
faqs.answer: Following specialisations are offered in the PhD programme at Adichunchanagiri University:PhD Civil engineering / Mechanical Engineering/ Electronics & Communication engineering/ Computer Science & Engg/ MathematicsPhD Anatomy/ Physiology/ Medical Biochemistry/ Microbiology/ Community Medicine/ Pathology/ Medical Pharmacology/ Forensic Medicine/ Radio-diagnosis.PhD Community Health NursingPhD Pharmaceutical Chemistry/ Pharmaceutics/ Pharmacy Practice/ Pharmaceutical Analysis/ Pharmaceutical Regulatory Affairs/ Pharmacology & PharmacognosyPhD Education/ Commerce/ KannadaPhD Biochemistry/ Biotechnology/ Microbiology/ Molecular Biology/ Physics/ Chemistry  and Library & Information ScienceThe selection criteria for PhD programme at Adichunchanagiri University is entrance based. Students must qualify both ACUET and the personal interview to get selected for admission into PhD courses at the university.

faqs.question: How many seats are available for Adichunchanagiri University BSc programme in 2025?
faqs.answer: Adichunchanagiri University offers a total of 240 seats. These seats are distributed across various specialisations. Popular speiclisations including BSc Nursing have 60 seats, in total. Seat allocation is based on merit in Class 12 or a valid KCET score, depending on the specialisation.
